### core.geometry (docs/reference/core/geometry.md)

- core.geometry.shapes.shape [built]: `shape(spec)` · `shape.make(params, seed)` · `shape.into(mesh, params, { at, turn, id })` · `shape.update(spec)` (a new definition: its builds let go, every layer placing it built again) · `shape.watch(fn)` · its params: `num(min, max, def)` · `int(min, max, def)` · `choice(opts, def)` · `color(def)` · `flag(def)` · `text(def, max)` (exported as `textParam`: `text` is the label mark) · a form for them: `form(shape)` · `.render(into, onChange)`
  params: `id?: string` · `params?: Record<string, Param>` · `build: (b, p, rand) => void` · `simple?: true | (b, p) => void` (its level 1: the build again with fewer sides and without what is whole-only, or a build of its own; unset: the whole stands in) · `far?: 'impostor' | 'box' | 'dot' | 'none' | (b, p) => void` (its far level; unset: the simple one stands in) · `budget?: { whole, simple, far }` · `defaults?: (given) => params` (its defaults by what is given: a type given brings its row of numbers, what is given besides stands over them) · `size?: { min?: px, max?: px }` (its range on screen: a shape kept within this many CSS px across its bounds, seen at its middle: core › render › drawing › size) · a param: as named
  returns: `Shape` · `Param` · a form: `{ controls }` (a slider, a stepper, a dropdown, a colour, a switch, a text box per param, with its range)
  e.g. `shape({ id: 'bin', params: { lid: color('#c43c2c') }, build: (b, p) => b.solid('box', { size: [.6, 1, .7], at: [0, .5, 0] }) })` · `params: { size: num(.3, 2, .6) }` · `form(bin).render(panel, (p) => pv.set(p))`
- core.geometry.shapes.builder.solid [built]: `b.solid(kind, o)` · `b.label(text, o)` · the finish, on every verb: `color` · `material` · `round` · `detail` · `tint` · `label` · `lamps`
  params: `kind: 'box' | 'cylinder' | 'sphere' | 'cone' | 'capsule'` · `size | radius` · `top?` (a cone's) · `at?: [x, y, z]` (its centre) · `axis?: 'x' | 'y' | 'z' = 'y'` · `turn?: degrees` · `sides?` · finish: `material?: 'matte' | 'painted' | 'glass' | 'metal' | 'emissive' | 'foliage' | 'water'` · `round?: m` · `detail?: 0 | 1 | 2` · `tint?: boolean` (it takes the instance's colour: `entities({ tint })`, `entity({ color })`; built into a mesh, `shape.into(mb, p, { tint })`) · `lamps?: 'head' | 'tail' | 'windows'` · `label?: text | { text, on?: 'front' | 'back' | 'left' | 'right' | 'top' = 'front', at?: [u, v], height?, color? }` · `b.label(text, { at, facing, along?, height = .3, off = .004 })`
  e.g. `b.solid('box', { size: [1, 1, 1], at: [0, .5, 0], round: .05 })` · `b.solid('box', { …, material: 'glass' })` · `b.solid('box', { size: [4.2, .7, 1.8], color: '#fff', tint: true, label: { text: 'TAXI', on: 'left' } })`
- core.geometry.shapes.builder.extrude [built]: `b.extrude(footprint, height, o)` (a sweep straight up)
  params: `footprint: [x, z][]` (lying flat: x east, z south) · `height: m` · `scale?` · `twist?` · `caps?` · `smooth?` · finish
  e.g. `b.extrude(plan, 3.2, { color: '#d8cbb0' })`
- core.geometry.shapes.builder.lathe [built]: `b.lathe(profile, o)` (a sweep round the vertical axis)
  params: `profile: [radius, height][]` · `segments?: int` (24 whole, 10 simple) · `angle?: degrees = 360` · `smooth?: boolean = true` · finish
  e.g. `b.lathe([[0, 0], [.3, 0], [.25, .8], [0, .9]], { material: 'glass' })`
- core.geometry.shapes.builder.sweep [built]: `b.sweep(profile, path, o)`
  params: `profile: [x, y][] | { circle, sides } | { rect }` · `path: [x, y, z][] | { up: h }` (a footprint extruded) `| { around: 'y', segments, angle }` (a lathe) · `scale?: n | [from, to]` (a taper) · `twist?: degrees` · `caps?` · `smooth?` · finish
  e.g. `b.sweep({ circle: .03 }, rail, { color: '#222' })`
- core.geometry.shapes.builder.copy [built]: `b.copy(fn, how)`
  params: `how: { mirror: 'x' | 'z', keep? } | { repeat: n, step?: [x, y, z], turn?, axis?: 'x' | 'y' | 'z' | [x, y, z], at?: [x, y, z] } (turned round any axis through `at`: blades round a hub) | { along: path, every: m, align? } | { scatter: ring, count, seed?, turn? } | { emit: { count: [whole, simple, far], life: s, rise?: m, spread?: m, grow?: ×, fade?: [opacity at birth, at death], drift?: [x, z] m over its life } }` (copies over time: each born again every `life` seconds at its own time, moved by its age on the chip, blended) · `fn: (b, i) => void` (each copy in its own frame)
  e.g. `b.copy((b, i) => b.solid('box', { at: [0, .45, i * .11] }), { repeat: 4 })` · smoke: `b.copy((b) => b.mesh(tri), { emit: { count: [28, 10, 0], life: 5, rise: 34, fade: [.75, 0] } })`
- core.geometry.shapes.builder.scope [built]: `b.scope(box | { footprint, height })` · `grammar(spec)` · a scope's `split` · `repeat` · `faces` · `inset` · `extrude` · `solid` · `panel` · `roof` · `build`
  params: `rules: Record<name, (scope, p, go, rand) => void>` · `start?: string` · `lot: p => { footprint, height } | { size, at, turn }` · `split(axis, [m | '*' | '~m'])` · `roof('flat' | 'gable' | 'hip' | 'dutch' | 'skillion' | 'pyramidal', { pitch, overhang, ridge: 'long' | 'short' | 'x' | 'z' = 'long', rise, high, ends })` (`roofFaces(form, w, d, opts)`: the same faces as triangles)
  returns: `Shape` (buildings and facades from a footprint, by a split grammar)
  e.g. `grammar({ lot: p => p.site, rules: { Lot: (s, p, go) => { s.solid('box'); for (const f of s.split('y', ['~3'])) go('Floor', f.faces().front) }, Floor: (s, p, go) => s.repeat('x', 3).forEach((b) => go('Bay', b)) } })`
- core.geometry.shapes.builder.mesh [built]: `b.mesh(triangles, o)`
  params: `triangles: [x, y, z][]` (three places a triangle, in the frame being built) · `smooth?: boolean` · `crease?: degrees = 50` · `lines?` · finish
  e.g. `b.mesh([[0, 0, 0], [1, 0, 0], [0, 1, 0]], { color: '#888' })`
- core.geometry.shapes.parts [built]: `b.part(name, fn, opts?)` · `b.anchor(name, at, opts?)` · `b.group(name, fn)` · `b.frame({ at, turn, scale }, fn)`
  params: part: `name: string` · `fn: (b) => void` · `pivot?: [x, y, z]` · `joint?: { kind: 'hinge' | 'wheel' | 'slider', axis: 'x' | 'y' | 'z' | [x, y, z], radius?: m (a wheel's), limits?: [min, max] (degrees; a slider's metres) }` (what can move and how: nothing moves it until a layer gives its driver: core › entities › kinematics) · anchor: `at: [x, y, z]` · `kind?: 'seat' | 'grip' | 'foot' | 'entry' | 'parking' | 'service' | 'light' | 'lie' | 'sit'` (what a kind's traits name: core › entities › identity › kind) · `heading?: degrees = 0`
  returns: a part: a movable piece (its triangles and pivot in the shape) · an anchor: a contact point · a group: a named set of triangles without a pivot · a frame: building moved, turned, scaled
  e.g. `b.part('lid', (b) => b.solid('box', { … }), { pivot: hinge })` · `b.anchor('driver', [1.8, .9, -.45], { kind: 'seat' })` · `b.group('cab', (b) => { … })`
- core.geometry.shapes.levels.full [built]: `solids({ pixels: { full } })` · automatic
  params: `full?: px = 120` · `margin?: share = .2` (`pixels: { full, simple, margin }`: a level changes only past its edge by this share)
  returns: the real form (level 0)
  e.g. `solids({ pixels: { full: 300 } })`
- core.geometry.shapes.levels.simple [built]: `shape({ simple: true })` (the build again at level 1) or `shape({ simple: (b, p) => … })` (a build of its own) · `finish: { detail }`
  params: `detail?: 0 | 1 | 2` on any verb (the coarsest level it is still drawn at: 0 the whole only, 1 the simple too, 2 also far, the default) · `pixels: { simple?: px = 25 }` (the edge below which the far level takes over) · none set: the whole stands in (pay only for what is set)
  returns: a simpler form
  e.g. `b.solid('box', { …, detail: 0 })`
- core.geometry.shapes.levels.box [built]: `shape({ far: 'box' })`
  returns: one box in the shape's colours
  e.g. `far: 'box'`
- core.geometry.shapes.levels.dot [built]: `shape({ far: 'dot' })`
  returns: a small solid in the shape's colours at its middle
  e.g. `far: 'dot'`
- core.geometry.shapes.levels.counted [built]: `solids({ counted })` · `entities({ counted })` · `vegetation({ counted })` · `streets({ counted })` (any instance layer) · `layer.cells()` · `layer.countedAt(s)`
  params: `counted?: { cell?: m = 1000, level: LevelSpec, size?: px = 13, color?, format?: n => text }` (counted at these observation levels: presence, changed once at a level change, never by the camera)
  returns: a number per area, nothing drawn per copy
  e.g. `streets({ …, counted: { cell: 250, level: 'street' } })` · `entities({ shape: bin, data, counted: { cell: 2000, level: { to: 'district' } } })`
- core.geometry.shapes.levels.impostor [built]: `impostor(shape, opts)` (the last of an instance set's levels)
  params: `views?: int = 8` (a hemi-octahedral grid of views a side) · `size?: px = views × 64` (the atlas)
  returns: a camera-facing card from a baked atlas of the shape seen from every side, lit by its baked normals
  e.g. `instances: [{ shape: [tree.whole, tree.simple, impostor(tree.whole)], data }]`
- core.geometry.shapes.instances [built]: `entities({ shape, data, params, variation })` · a solids layer's `instances: false` (its repeated shapes, a street level's trees, left out from the next frame)
  params: `shape: Shape | Made` (a shape built for each feature's params, or a made one placed as it is: a model from `shapes.import`) · `data: Source | Feature[]` (points; lines and areas at their middle) · `params?: d => Partial<P>` · `at?: d => [lon, lat, h?]` · `heading?: d => degrees` · `scale?: d => number` · `variation?: { seed?: d => any = d.id, color?: number = 0 (how much colour varies), scale?: number = 0, builds?: int = 1 (distinct seeded builds of each params) }` · each clone's own look, no build: `tint?: d => Color` · `tints?: { [group]: d => Color | undefined }` (its groups' colours: a group built with `b.group(name, fn)`, no `tint` flag needed; undefined: the group's own) · `stretch?: d => k` (along its height: a taller tower; a part a joint moves rides along at its stretched pivot, itself not stretched: a rotor stays round) · `joints?: { [part | kind]: driver | d => driver }` (core › entities › kinematics) · `attach?: [{ shape, at: anchor name | kind, params? }]` (a shape at every clone's anchor: core › entities › placement › attach) · `size?: { min, max }` (its range on screen; default the shape's)
  returns: element
  e.g. `entities({ shape: bin, data: bins, heading: d => d.props.facing })` · `variation: { seed: d => d.id, color: .05, builds: 3 }` · `tints: { roof: d => roofs[d.props.kind] }, stretch: d => d.props.levels / 2`
- core.geometry.shapes.checks [built]: `shape.check(with?)` · `shape.check({ kind })` · `preview(shape, opts)`
  params: check: `with?`: what it is built on besides its params (a footprint) · `kind?`: a kind (or its name) its traits are checked against (default the shape's own `kind`) · `timeMs?` · preview: `canvas` · `params?` · `levels?: boolean = true` (side by side, one per level) · `distance?: true` (one copy, a slider walking the camera away) · `graphics?`
  returns: `{ ok, problems[], triangles: { whole, simple, far }, builds }` · `Preview` (`set(params)`, `triangles`, `world`, `dispose`)
  e.g. `expect(bin.check().ok).toBe(true)` · `await preview(bin, { canvas, distance: true })`
- core.geometry.shapes.recipes.branching [built]: `recipes.branching(spec)`
  params: `trunk: { height, radius, lean?, clear? }` · `levels: { count, angle, length, taper, start?, bend? }[]` · `leaves?: { kind: 'broad' | 'narrow' | 'needle', size, density, colors }` · `crown?: 'round' | 'conical' | 'columnar' | 'vase'` · `bark?` · `method?: 'recursive' | 'colonize' = 'recursive'` (space colonisation grows towards points in the crown) · `seed?`
  returns: `{ levels: [whole, simple, far], height, crownRadius, crownBase, transmissivity }` (instance shapes; an impostor of the whole for far away)
  e.g. `recipes.branching({ trunk: { height: 9, radius: .3 }, levels: [{ count: 5, angle: 40, length: .6, taper: .7 }] })`
- core.geometry.shapes.recipes.kitbash [built]: `recipes.kitbash(kit, layout, o)`

  returns: `Shape` (the pieces built into one)
  e.g. `recipes.kitbash({ arch, pier }, [{ piece: 'arch', at: [0, 0, 0] }, { piece: 'pier', at: [6, 0, 0] }])`
- core.geometry.shapes.recipes.presets [built]: `preset(shape, name, params)`
  params: `name: string` · `params: Partial<P>`
  returns: `Shape` (the same build, these as its defaults)
  e.g. `preset(bin, 'recycling', { lid: '#e8c22c' })`
- core.geometry.shapes.recipes.package [built]: `shapePackage({ info, shape, presets?, kinematics?, states? })` · `pkg.preset(name)` · `pkg.make(preset | params, seed?)` · `pkg.check()` · `w.shapes.use(pkg)` · `w.shapes.make(id, preset | params)` · `w.shapes.list()` · `w.shapes.load(catalogueUrl, { only? })` · a folder: `shape.ts`, `shape.json`, `presets.json`, `kinematics.ts`, `states.ts`, `thumbs/`, `test.ts`, `LICENCE`
  params: `info: { id, name, version, licence (SPDX), author?, about?, tags?, thumbs? }` · `presets: { name: params }` · `kinematics: { joint: { part, kind: 'wheel' | 'hinge' | 'slider', axis, limits?, radius? (m or a param's name), steer? } }` · `states: { name: { joint: value } }` · a catalogue: `{ packages: [{ id, module, info? }] }` (each module's default export a package)
  returns: `ShapePackage` · `PackageCheck` (`{ ok, problems, shape, presets }`)
  e.g. `w.shapes.use(cars.package)` · `w.shapes.make('car', 'pickup')` · `await w.shapes.load('/shapes/catalogue.json')`
- core.geometry.import.gltf [partly]: `shapes.import(url, opts)`
  params: `url: string` (a .glb, or a .gltf with its buffers) · `length?: m` or `scale?` · `paint?: 'auto' | Color | false = 'auto'` (the colour family that takes each instance's colour; its shades kept) · `tolerance?` · `turn?: degrees` · `fetch?` · `kind?: kind | name` · `anchors?: Anchor[] | { name: { at, kind, heading } } | (made) => …` (its frame as made: an adapter from its bounds) · `params?` (what its kind reads: levels) · planned: `parts?`, `levels?`
  returns: `Promise<Made>` (a made shape: instanced as any; given a kind, it carries its traits)
  what is there: static meshes placed by their nodes, colours from base colours and palette textures, scaled, the foot at 0; given a kind, its anchors and params: a downloaded house serves as a house; no skins, morphs, animation, parts or simplified levels
  e.g. `await shapes.import('/models/sedan.glb', { length: 4.6 })` · `await shapes.import(url, { scale: 8.5, kind: 'house', anchors: (m) => ({ 'entry-1': { at: [0, 0, m.bounds[1][2] + .8], kind: 'entry', heading: 180 } }) })`
- core.geometry.landform.compose.exclusion [partly]: `{ excludes }` on any layer or piece · `comp.exclude(footprint, what)`

  returns: the lower layers' things inside the footprint are removed (never deleted from their source)
  what is there: [proposed]

- core.geometry.networks.analysis.graph [built]: `network({ lines, snap?, keep?, cost? })` · `network.from(lines, opts)`

- core.geometry.networks.analysis.routing [built]: `net.route(from, to)` · `net.shortest(sources, { toward? })` · `net.matrix(from[], to[])`
  params: `from, to: [lon, lat]` · `sources: { at | node, cost? }[]` (many at once: multi-source) · `max?: number` · `toward?: boolean` (the costs from each node to its nearest source, `prev` the next node on the way: a destination's tree)
  returns: `{ line, cost }` · `Shortest { dist, prev, costAt(p), pathFrom(p) }` · `number[][]` (rows by `from`; Infinity: not reachable)
  e.g. `net.matrix(homes, schools)`
- core.geometry.networks.analysis.isochrones [built]: `net.isochrone(from, within, opts?)`
  params: `from: Point | Point[] | sources` (each with the cost it starts at) `| pass` (a `net.shortest(…)` already made: its costs used as they are, no second pass) · `within: number[]` (cost bands) · `cell?: m = 25` · `reach?: m = 60` (off the network) · `off?: = 1.2` (cost a metre off it) · `max?`
  returns: areas (Features: Polygon or MultiPolygon, holes where a block is out of reach)
  e.g. `net.isochrone(entrances, [400, 800])` · `net.isochrone(net.shortest(entrances), [400, 800])`
- core.geometry.networks.analysis.nearest [built]: `net.nearest(point, opts?)`

- core.geometry.networks.walkways [built]: `walkways(sections, junctions)` · `network.walkways(opts)`
  params: `sections`, `junctions` (core › geometry › networks) · planned: `from?: Network`, `crossings?: 'auto' | Source`
  returns: the footpaths' middle lines: each section's (cut back at its junctions) and round each corner (`{ line, of, side, width }`)
  e.g. `network({ lines: walkways(sections, junctions).map((w) => …) })`
- core.geometry.networks.sections [partly]: `profileFor(cls, { reserve?, tags?, width?, lanes? }, rules)` · `reserveAcross(line, reservePolygons)` · `VIC_STREETS`
  params: `cls` (0 freeway … 5 local) · `reserve: { left, right }` (each side's property line: rays across the reserve polygon, Vicmap road casements) · `tags`: `lanes`, `width`, `sidewalk`, `sidewalk:left/right(:width)` · `rules: ProfileRules` (carriageway, lanes, reserve, footpath, kerb, median, the gap to the boundary, by class: Victoria's street types)
  returns: `Profile` (carriageway, lanes, median, each side's kerb, nature strip, footpath, gap; where it came from: reserve, tags or class) · `Section` (centre line, profile, cut-backs)
  what is there: profiles from data, tags and rules, built per tile by the street level; baked by the roads compile with heights solved over the whole network (`solveHeights`: grade limits, decks, tunnels, crossings held 5.9 m apart) and a crown
  e.g. `profileFor(5, { reserve: reserveAcross(pts, casements) })`
- core.geometry.networks.junctions [partly]: `solveJunctions(sections, opts?)`
  params: `radius?: (cls) => m` (kerb returns: 7.5 m residential, 12.5 m collector, 15 m arterial; the smaller arm's) · `crossings?: (cls) => boolean` (default collector and bigger)
  returns: `Junction[]`: arms sorted by angle, each cut back where its neighbours stop overlapping, the platform (the arms' mouths and a kerb return at each corner), the verge bands (kerb, strip, footpath) carried round each corner, crossings at the mouths, give-way lines on the smaller arms
  what is there: solved per tile from all a junction's arms, the platform drawn by the tile it lies in; baked by the roads compile in polygons: every road buffered, one union per level, each junction's concave corners closed by the smaller road's radius, slivers and pinholes dropped, junction zones (where buffers overlap) planar; the kerb last, along the final outline
  e.g. `solveJunctions(sections)`
- core.geometry.networks.structures.bridges [partly]: `{ kind: 'bridge' }` · `structures.bridge(opts)`
  params: `depth?: metres = 1.2` · `parapet?: 'wall' | 'rail' | Shape = 'wall'` · `piers?: PierSpec`
  returns: a deck with its spans and parapets
  what is there: baked by the roads compile from `bridge` / `layer`: a 1.2 m deck, parapets, deck sides and underside, abutments, 4.5 m clear over what it crosses; the options planned
  e.g. `structures.bridge({ parapet: 'rail' })`
- core.geometry.networks.structures.piers [partly]: `structures.piers(opts)`
  params: `every?: metres = 30` · `shape?: Shape` · `to?: 'ground' = 'ground'` (down to the ground under the deck)
  returns: piers under a raised edge
  what is there: baked by the roads compile: every ~30 m, two under a wide deck, down to the ground; the options planned
  e.g. `structures.piers({ every: 25 })`
- core.geometry.networks.structures.decks [partly]: `{ kind: 'deck' }` · `structures.deck(opts)`

- core.geometry.networks.clamp [partly]: `LEVELS` · `skirts(edge, top)`

  what is there: skirts; with baked roads, `clampTerrain(terrain, clamp.json, { under })`: the ground lowered under each level's surface and level with the kerb's foot for 4 m beside it, then a batter, recomputed on the device, never baked into the height map …
  e.g. `skirts(line, LEVELS.kerb)`

### core.encoding (docs/reference/core/encoding.md)

- core.encoding.marks.symbols.point [built]: `points(options)`
  params: `size?: Fn<number> | { m | px: Fn<number>, min?, max? } = 8` (CSS px, or metres within a range of CSS px: render › drawing › instancing) · `color?: Fn<color> = '#fff'` · `outline?: number = 0` · `restyle?: seconds` (as a line's) · `drape?` (marks/drape; default 'above': never hidden) · `behind?: number = .35` (above: its opacity where something stands in front)
  returns: element (on the chip: its place and its feature; colour, size and state read by the feature; floating, drawn twice: in front at full opacity, behind things at `behind` of it)
  e.g. `points({ data, size: d => Math.sqrt(d.props.mw) })`
- core.encoding.marks.symbols.icon [built]: `icon(options)` · `icons(images, { size? })` (the app's own pictures in one atlas)
  params: `of: id | Element | Source | array` (a set's things by reference: turned along their paths, giving way to its shapes near the camera as its dots do; or features) · `icons: IconAtlas` (`icons({ name: url | image | canvas | (g, size) => draw }, { size: px = 64 })`: a cell each, one texture; a URL through the world's loader) · `icon: Fn<string>` (its picture's name) · `size?: px | { px | m, min, max } = 24` (the one size rule) · `color?: Fn<Color>` (a tint: white as drawn) · `heading?: true | d => degrees` (as the screen sees it) · `lift?` · `at?` · `tooltip?` · `onTap?` · `select?` · `pickable?`
  returns: element
  e.g. `icon({ of: 'fleet', icons: pics, icon: d => d.props.kind, heading: true, size: { m: 9, min: 14, max: 30 } })`
- core.encoding.marks.symbols.text [built]: `text(options)`
  params: `text: (d, s) => string | number` · `size?: Fn<number> | { m | px: Fn<number>, min?, max? } = 12` (metres: each label drawn at the size it is shown, in steps; `restepped` counts them) · `color?` · `halo?: number | { width, color } = 2` · `font?: { family, weight }` · `anchor?: 'center' | 'top' | 'bottom' | 'left' | 'right'` · `offset?: [x, y]` · `priority?: d => number` (higher first, then the feature's id: one order decided when the data comes, never by the view) · `collide?: boolean | 'own' = true` (every label mark's labels make room together, the top of the stack first, with hysteresis; 'own': its own labels only) · `at?: d => [lon, lat, h?]` · `drape?` (marks/drape; default 'above': always on top) · `occlude?: boolean` (the older name: true is drape 'ground', hidden by buildings and hills in front; false is 'above')
  returns: element (labels make room for each other and fade; on the ground hidden behind the terrain and extrusions; reveal type / count / mask / fade)
  e.g. `text({ data: towns, text: d => d.props.name, priority: d => d.props.pop })`
- core.encoding.marks.lines.line [built]: `line(options)`
  params: `width?: Fn<number> | { m | px: Fn<number>, min?, max? } = 2` (CSS px, or metres within a range of CSS px; an arc's and a trail's the same) · `color?: Fn<color> | Scale` · `dashes?: [on, off]` (px) · `flow?: number = 0` (the dashes move along, px a second, start → end; frames only while shown) · `glow?: number = .5` (pulse) · `value?: Fn<number>` (hooks) · `on?: 'ground' | 'sea' | 'absolute' = 'ground'` (follows the terrain and the globe) · `detail?: { step: metres }` · `blend?: 'alpha' | 'add' | 'multiply' | 'screen' = 'alpha'` · `restyle?: seconds` (new colours or numbers eased on the chip; default `transition` when set, else 0: drawn the next frame) · `groundMarks?: 'tiles' | 'prisms' | 'auto'` · `drape?` (marks/drape; default 'ground'; `over: true` is the older name of 'above')
  returns: element (mitred joins, anti-aliased; reveal trace / pulse / fade; hooks color, alpha, reveal)
  e.g. `line({ data: grid, width: d => d.props.kv / 100, reveal: { mode: 'trace', from: substation, head: { glow: .8 } } })`
- core.encoding.marks.lines.arc [built]: `arc(options)`
  params: `from: d => [lon, lat]` · `to: d => [lon, lat]` · `height?: Fn<number>` (metres at the middle; default a quarter of the distance, at most 1,500 km; 0 lies on the ground) · `fromHeight?` / `toHeight?: Fn<number>` (metres over the ground at each end) · `drape?` (marks/drape; default 'above': drawn over the world, order 4.5; `over` its older name, `over: false` is 'ground') · `points?: int | { every?: m = 25, min? = 8, max? = 64 }` (by length by default; at most 513) · and every line option (`width`, `color`, `dashes`, `flow`, `blend`, hover, tooltip, tap)
  returns: element: the great circle, rising between ends on the ground (× exaggeration); each arc one record of 40 bytes (its ends, their heights, the rise, its feature, its segments) drawn as an instance of one shared strip, the points made on the graphics chip (more points: the chip's time only, no memory); a restyle writes no record, new data only the records …
  e.g. `arc({ data: flows, from: d => [d.props.olon, d.props.olat], to: d => [d.props.dlon, d.props.dlat], width: d => Math.sqrt(d.props.n) / 40 })`
- core.encoding.marks.lines.trail [built]: `trail(options)`
  params: `times?: d => (ms | Date)[]` (one per point of the feature's line; default `d.props.times`) · `window?: seconds = 600` (the tail drawn behind now) · `head?: number = .6` (glow) · `clock?: s => ms | Date` (default the world's time) · and every line option
  returns: element: drawn up to the time, fading over the window; scrubbing the time (`w.setTime`) moves every trail on the graphics, no rebuild; `along` in hooks is the time
  e.g. `trail({ data: trips, times: d => d.props.dt.map(s => d.props.t0 + s * 1000), window: 900 })`
- core.encoding.marks.areas.area [built]: `area(options)`
  params: `color?: Fn<color> | Scale` · `outline?: number | { width, color } = 0` · `opacity?: number = 1` · `height?: Fn<number> = 0` (metres over the ground) · `value?: Fn<number>` · `on?` · `detail?: { step: metres }` (edges split to follow the terrain; rings touching ±180° stay whole) · `blend?: 'alpha' | 'add' | 'multiply' | 'screen'` · `restyle?: seconds` (new colours or numbers eased on the chip; default `transition` when set, else 0: drawn the next frame) · `groundMarks?: 'tiles' | 'prisms' | 'auto'` · `drape?` (marks/drape; default 'over': a choropleth still reads in a dense twin)
  returns: element (reveal trace-fill / grow / wipe / radial / sweep / fade; hooks position, color, alpha, reveal)
  e.g. `area({ data: suburbs, color: scale.quantile(d => d.props.rate, { range: 'reds' }) })`
- core.encoding.marks.areas.extrusion [built]: `extrusion(options)`
  params: `height?: Fn<number> = 10` (metres) · `color?: Fn<color> | Scale` · `value?` · `blend?` · stands on the lowest ground under its footprint
  returns: element (walls and roof, lit; reveal rise / pop / sweep / fade; hooks position, color, alpha, reveal)
  e.g. `extrusion({ data: buildings, height: d => d.props.levels * 3.2, reveal: 'rise' })`
- core.encoding.marks.areas.raster [built]: `raster(options)`
  params: `source: RasterSource` (`raster.xyz` · `raster.wms` · `raster.field` · `raster.custom`) · `opacity?: number = 1` · `blend?: 'normal' | 'multiply' | 'screen' | 'add' = 'normal'` · `when?` · or one picture over a box: `source: raster.image({ url?, image?, bounds: [w, s, e, n], attribution? })`, or one picture of the view: `source: raster.wms(url, { layers, single: true })` · `raster.view({ url: (box, width, height) => string })`, with an area's props (`opacity`, `drape` (default 'over'), `when`, `order`, `reveal`) · `legend?: Legend` (for a layer list; a picture of a WMS: its GetLegendGraphic)
  returns: element: tiled sources painted into the ground in draw order (drape on the terrain, under every mark; their opacity paints the tiles again); a picture drawn on the chip as a draped area (its opacity a uniform: one frame; stacked anywhere among the other layers; ground, over or above as an area); a picture of the view the same …
  e.g. `raster({ id: 'solar', source: raster.field({ value: ghi, ramp: 'inferno', domain: [3, 7] }), opacity: .6 })` · `raster({ id: 'canopy', source: raster.image({ url: '/canopy.png', bounds }), opacity: .8 })`
- core.encoding.marks.drape [built]: where a mark sits with the twin: a layer's `drape`; how marks on the ground are drawn: world option `groundMarks: 'prisms' | 'tiles'`, a layer's own `groundMarks` (wins)
  params: `drape?: 'ground' | 'over' | 'above' | true | false`: 'ground' on the terrain and the twin's own ground (what lies on it: its roads', paths' and water's meshes, within `GROUND_WITHIN` = 1.5 m of the terrain): what stands on it is never painted (buildings, trees, benches, a set's things, bodies: a solids layer's `stands`, a draw's) · 'over' painted onto everything under it (terrain, roofs, walls, tree crowns; on bare terrain the same as 'ground') · 'above' floating over everything, never hidden (a point behind something at `BEHIND` = .35 of its opacity) · true or unset: the mark's default, in one place (`DRAPE_DEFAULTS`: areas and pictures 'over', lines 'ground', points, labels and arcs 'above') · false: each vertex at the ground's height plus `lift` · groundMarks `'prisms'`: each piece of a mark lying on the ground drawn as a prism, every pixel finds the ground under it (exact; one face per piece on level ground; the default at quality realistic) · `'tiles'`: drawn into the ground's tiles and shown with them (one pass, drawn again only when something changes; lines, outlines and dashes as wide and as long as the prisms: each tile's scale from the camera when it is drawn) · unset at quality lite (WebGL2, phones): each mark into the tiles only where they pay (relief under it, and it holds still), else the flat or prism route
  returns: `w.groundMarks` · `layer.sits`
  e.g. `area({ data, drape: 'ground' })` · `world(canvas, { groundMarks: 'tiles' })`
- core.encoding.marks.custom [built]: `custom({ data, at, size? (CSS px facing the screen, metres on the ground, or `{ m | px, min?, max? }`), shape?, attributes?, uniforms?, varyings?, vertex?, fragment?, functions?, blend? })` · your own geometry: `custom({ geometry, primitive?, at, data?, attributes?, uniforms?, varyings?, vertex?, fragment?, blend?, depth?, side?, pointSize?, cast?, size?: { min?, max? } (each copy within a range of CSS px across) })`
  params: quads: `shape?: 'screen' | 'ground' = 'screen'` (one quad per item: CSS px facing you, or metres on the ground) · geometry (like a BufferGeometry): `{ positions, normals?, uvs?, colors?, attributes?: { name: { data, size } }, index? }` in metres from each copy's place (x east, y up, z south) · `primitive?: 'triangles' | 'lines' | 'points'` (points: squares of `pointSize` CSS px, `corner` across them) · `data` + `at`: a copy per datum with its own `attributes` (instances; blended copies drawn the farthest first) · `uniforms: { name: number | [..] | '#rrggbb' | { image } }` (an image or canvas: `tex_name(uv)`) · `blend?: 'none' | 'alpha' | 'add' | 'multiply'` · `depth?: { test?, write? }` · `side?: 'front' | 'back' | 'double'` · `order` (draw order) · `vertex` / `fragment`: statements in the WGSL subset (`eye`, `origin` for billboards; `lambert(normal)` the sky's light)
  returns: a layer of your own visualisation, the same on WebGPU and WebGL2
  e.g. `custom({ geometry: box, data, at: d => d.at, uniforms: { photo: { image } }, fragment: 'color = vec4f(tex_photo(uv).rgb * lambert(normal), 1.0);' })`
- core.encoding.scales [built]: `scale.linear | log | sqrt | quantile | quantize | threshold | jenks | pretty | category (value, opts)`
  params: `value: d => number` · `domain?: [a, b] | breaks | categories | 'auto' = 'auto'` ('auto': read once from the whole source when it is complete, and again only when the data changes (simulation, time, rows joined anew), never when the view moves; over a tiled source 'auto' is an error with its fix: give the domain) · `range?: Ramp | [from, to] | looks[]` · `n?: int = 5` · `clamp?: boolean = true` · `missing?` · `reverse?` · category: `map?`, `other?`
  returns: `d => look` (usable as any prop; the same value, the same look, always) · `scale.legend()` · `scale.breaks`
  e.g. `color: scale.quantile(d => d.props.rate, { range: 'reds', n: 5 })`
- core.encoding.layers.layer [built]: `layer(options)` · a mark alone is a layer of one sign (`area`, `line`, `points` …)
  params: `id: string` · `label?: string` · `data: Source | Feature[]` (loaded once, shared by its signs) · its signs, each a mark's options without `data`: `area?` (fill and outline), `line?`, `points?`, `extrusion?`, `labels?` (below) · `when?` (none by default: no gate) · `opacity?` · `tooltip?`, `hover?`, `onTap?`, `onHover?`, `select?`, `drape?` (shared by its signs)
  returns: `Layer` (an element: one id, one switch, one opacity, one place in the stack, one pick: a sign's feature reported as the layer's; `layer.signs`, `layer.labels`, `layer.joined`)
  e.g. `layer({ id: 'suburbs', data, area: { color: scale.quantile(km2) }, labels: { text: d => d.props.name } })`
- core.encoding.layers.labels [built]: a layer's `labels: { … }` (a layer of names alone: `layer({ data, labels })`)
  params: the text mark's options (`text`, `priority`, `size`, `color`, `halo`, `font`, `anchor`, `offset`, `at`, `collide`, `feature`, `filter`) with readable defaults (`halo: 2`, `collide: true`, `size: 12`)
  returns: labels decided once: an anchor per feature computed once (a point's place, a line's middle, a place well inside an area's largest part), the text and priority read when the data comes, one fixed order (priority, then the feature's id), collision with hysteresis in time (decided from scratch in that order each frame, the same on every device …
  e.g. `labels: { text: d => d.props.name, priority: d => d.props.pop }`
- core.encoding.layers.legend [built]: a layer's `legend` · the layer list and `legend(w, { for: id })` read it
  params: `legend?: Legend | Scale` (default its first sign's colour scale: `layer.props.color`)
  returns: its classes, ramp or categories, from the whole data (the same at every zoom)
  e.g. `legend(w, { for: 'suburbs', title: 'km²' })`
- core.encoding.layers.stack [built]: its place in the stack: `order` · `above` · `below` · `w.reorder(ids)` · `w.move(id, to)` (core › world › elements › order)
  params: `ids: string[]` (bottom first)
  returns: each layer keeps its band (fills on the ground, floating over); its labels take the same place among every layer's labels
  e.g. `w.reorder(['zones', 'suburbs', 'creeks', 'places'])`
- core.encoding.join [built]: automatic on every mark and layer: features keyed by id
  params: `key?: (d) => string | number` (default the feature's id)
  returns: new: built and revealed; changed: only it restyled or rebuilt (`restyle` eases it); gone: it leaves; stayed: nothing (never faded in again, never blinks) · `layer.joined: { new, changed, gone, stayed }` (the last change, counted)
  e.g. `w.element('buses').joined` → `{ new: 2, changed: 31, gone: 1, stayed: 412 }`

not there yet (planned, proposed or open; do not use):
  core.encoding.marks.lines.arrows, core.encoding.marks.areas.grid, core.encoding.marks.areas.rings

### core.render (docs/reference/core/render.md)

- core.render.graphics.interface [built]: `Graphics { buffer, texture, target, layerTarget, copyLayers, program, frame, readTexture, caps, stats, lost, bytes, destroy }`
  params: `TextureDesc { width, height, layers?, growable? (its layers copied into a bigger one: `copyLayers(from, to, layers)`, a pool grown by need; false where WebGL2 cannot draw into floats, or when the copy did not land: the pool stays as it was), format: 'rgba8' | 'rgba32f' | 'r32f', filter?, renderable? }` · `ProgramDesc { wgsl, glsl: { vertex, fragment }, blocks, textures, instance?, vertex?, blend, depth, cull, overlay?, format? }` · `FrameOptions { clear, read?, target? }`
  returns: handles · `Promise<pixels>` · `Promise<Float32Array | Uint8Array>`
  e.g. `g.frame([{ program, blocks, textures, count: 3 }], { target: g.layerTarget(next, 0), clear: [0, 0, 0, 0] })`
- core.render.graphics.webgpu [built]: `world(canvas, { graphics: 'webgpu' })`
  returns: the WebGPU implementation
  e.g. `graphics: 'webgpu'`
- core.render.graphics.webgl2 [built]: `world(canvas, { graphics: 'webgl2' })`
  returns: the WebGL2 implementation; starts at `lite`
  e.g. `graphics: 'webgl2'`
- core.render.graphics.caps [built]: `supported()` · `w.caps`
  returns: `{ api: 'webgpu' | 'webgl2' | null, compute, timer, floatTargets, maxTex, f16, tier }`
  e.g. `if (!(await supported()).api) showUnsupported()`
- core.render.graphics.shaders.wgsl [built]: `shader({ wgsl })`
  params: `wgsl: string` (written first)
  returns: a shader half
  e.g. `mesh.wgsl.ts`
- core.render.graphics.shaders.glsl [built]: `shader({ glsl })`
  params: `glsl: string` (the twin, GLSL ES 3.0) · your own shader lines (reveal and extension hooks): [open] a small WGSL → GLSL writer, your decision
  returns: a shader half
  e.g. `mesh.glsl.ts`
- core.render.graphics.shaders.translate [built]: `translateStatements(code, scope)` · `translateModule(code)`
  params: `code: string` (the WGSL subset: scalars, vectors, matrices, fixed arrays, let / var / const, if / for / while, functions, the math built-ins, swizzles; not yet: your own structs, textures, pointers, `loop`)
  returns: GLSL ES 3.0, or an `E-SHADER-001` error with your line, column and the fix
  e.g. `translateStatements('color = vec4f(1.0);', scope)`
- core.render.graphics.shaders.hooks [built]: `shader: { color, position, alpha, reveal, functions }` on a layer · `params: { gain: 1.5 }` · `layer.setShader(code)`
  params: per hook point, documented inputs (`position`, `normal`, `uv`, `value`, `time`, `params.<name>`) and outputs (`color`, `position`, `size`, `alpha`)
  returns: your code in the WGSL program as written and in the GLSL twin translated; params are uniforms (`w.set('id.gain', 2)`); `setShader` swaps live and keeps the old program if the new one fails
  e.g. `points({ data, params: { gain: 2 }, shader: { color: 'color = vec4f(color.rgb * params.gain, color.a);' } })`
- core.render.graphics.parity [built]: `parity(scene, opts)` (a CI tool)
  params: `scene: SceneFile` · `max?: number = 1` (mean difference out of 255)
  returns: `{ mean, max, pass }`
  e.g. `parity('crates.json')` → `{ mean: .94, pass: true }`
- core.render.drawing.renderer [built]: owned by the world: device, frame loop, resize, dispose
  params: `pixelRatio?: number = min(devicePixelRatio, 2)` · `fps?: 60 | 30 = 60`
  e.g. `world(canvas, { render: { pixelRatio: 1.5 } })`
- core.render.drawing.instancing [built]: automatic for shapes and points · one size rule for every mark and shape: a point's, a quad's or a label's `size: n | { px, min?, max? } | { m, min?, max? }`, a line's, an arc's or a trail's `width` the same, a shape's `size: { min?, max? }` (`shape({ size })`, `entities({ size })`, a set's `near.size`) · `sizePxAt(v, units, dist, mpp)`
  params: `max?: int = 65536` per draw · a size: CSS px (a value or your function of the feature), or `m` metres, either kept within `min`..`max` CSS px
  returns: one draw per mesh
  e.g. `points({ data, size: { m: 40, min: 4, max: 32 } })` · `line({ data, width: { m: d => d.props.lanes * 3.5, min: 1 } })` · `shape({ build, far, size: { min: 8, max: 40 } })`
- core.render.drawing.text [built]: `text({ data, text, size, halo, collide })`
  params: `text: Fn<string>` · `size?: Fn<number> = 12` · `halo?: number = 1.5` · `collide?: boolean = true`
  returns: element
  e.g. `text({ data: towns, text: d => d.props.name })`
- core.render.drawing.quality [built]: `world(canvas, { render: { quality } })` (or `{ quality }`) · `w.setQuality(q | null)` · `s.render.quality`
  params: `quality: 'auto' | Fn<'lite' | 'realistic'>` (a value or your function of the state; `'auto'`, the default: the device's pick, lite on WebGL2, touch screens and low tiers (memory, cores), with the reason in `w.reason` and `w.telemetry().quality`)
  e.g. `quality: s => (s.device.tier === 'high' ? 'realistic' : 'lite')`
- core.render.look.materials [built]: `material` on every builder verb and in raw meshes (`mb.material(code)`) · `material(kind, opts)` · `material.custom({ fragment, vertex?, uniforms?, varyings?, functions?, blend? })` · a solids layer's `imagery: { source, zoom }` and `windows: { lit, interior }`
  params: `kind: 'matte' | 'concrete' | 'painted' | 'glass' | 'metal' | 'emissive' | 'foliage' | 'water' | 'flat' | 'facade' | 'imagery' | 'interior' | 'pbr' | 'wire' | 'ghost'` · pbr `roughness?: 0..1 = .5`, `metal?: 0..1 = 0` · ghost `opacity?: 0..1 = .35` · imagery: the layer's `imagery: { source: RasterSource, zoom?: 17, size?: px = 512 }` · custom: your fragment (`color`, `base`, `normal`, `position`, `id`, `time`, varyings, `params.*`) and vertex code (`position`, `normal`) in the WGSL subset, `m.set(name, v)`
  returns: `Material`
  e.g. `b.solid('sphere', { radius: 4, material: material('pbr', { roughness: .25, metal: 1 }) })` · `b.solid('box', { size: [20, 30, 20], material: 'facade' })`
- core.render.look.shadows [built]: `world(canvas, { render: { shadows } })` · `w.setShadows(o)`
  params: `shadows?: boolean | { from: 'sun', distance: 2000 } = false`
  e.g. `render: { shadows: { distance: 1500 } }`
- core.render.style.ramp [built]: `ramp(name | colours | stops | fn, opts?)` · `colours(ramp, n)`
  params: `name: 'viridis' | 'inferno' | 'magma' | 'plasma' | 'turbo' | 'cividis' | 'reds' | 'blues' | 'greens' | 'oranges' | 'purples' | 'greys' | 'ylorrd' | 'ylgnbu' | 'rdylgn' | 'rdbu' | 'spectral' | 'category' | 'set2' | 'pastel'` · or `[t, colour][]` · `reverse?`
  returns: `(t: 0..1) => colour` (`.stops`)
  e.g. `ramp([[0, '#023'], [1, '#f80']])(0.4)`
- core.render.style.blend [partly]: `blend: mode` on any element
  params: `mode: 'normal' | 'multiply' | 'screen' | 'add' = 'normal'`
  what is there: rasters and the ground: built; vector layers: planned
  e.g. `raster({ id: 'night', blend: 'screen' })`
- core.render.style.theme [built]: an analysis view: `world(canvas, { theme })` · `w.setTheme(t | null, { seconds? })` · `w.theme` · `w.themeNow` · `theme.dark | grey | light (opts?)` · `theme.none()` · `theme.custom(spec)` · `theme.define(spec)` (a preset of your own) · a layer's `subject: true`
  params: `grey?: 0..1 = 1` · `tint?: colour` · `tintAmount?: 0..1 = .75` (with a tint) · `brightness?: number = 1` · `contrast?: number = 1` · `ground?: number = 1` (× the ground's brightness after the rest: darker than what stands on it) · `sky?: { amount?: 0..1 = 1, color? } | false` (the sky and its haze, through the sky's own `dim`) · `subjects?: string[] | (layer) => boolean` · `ramp?: Ramp = 'viridis'` (the subjects' one colour scale) · `seconds?: number = 1` · `when?: When` · presets: `dark` (blue-grey, the ground .55, the sky '#151c28'), `grey`, `light`
  returns: `Theme { name, spec, ramp, scale.linear | quantile | category … (value, opts), subject(layer), mute(rgb, amount) }`
  e.g. `w.setTheme(theme.dark({ subjects: ['transit'], ramp: 'turbo' }))` · `line({ id: 'transit', data, subject: true, color: t.scale.category((d) => d.props.route) })` · `world(canvas, { theme: theme.grey({ when: { toggle: 'analysis' } }) })`
- core.render.project.project [built]: `w.project(at)`
  params: `at: [lon, lat, h?] | point name`
  returns: `[x, y] | null` (screen pixels; null when behind the camera)
  e.g. `const xy = w.project('fault.mid')`
- core.render.project.visible [built]: `w.visible(at)`
  params: `at: [lon, lat, h?] | point name`
  returns: `boolean` (false when terrain hides it)
  e.g. `if (w.visible(peak)) label.show()`
- core.render.reveal.modes [built]: `reveal: mode | { mode }` · `reveal: { video, app }` (world option `context`) · `w.reveal(id)` · `w.hide(id)` · `w.release(id)`
  params: line: `trace` (from a place with `from`, a soft front `soft`, a glowing head `head: { glow }`), `pulse`, `fade` · area: `trace-fill`, `grow`, `wipe`, `radial`, `sweep`, `fade` · point, extrusion: `sweep`, `pop`, `rise`, `fade` · text: `type`, `count`, `mask`, `fade`
  returns: — (plays when shown changes; backwards when hidden; new features play theirs)
  e.g. `line({ data, reveal: { mode: 'trace', from: substation, head: { glow: 1 } } })`
- core.render.reveal.timing [built]: `reveal: { dur, ease, stagger, order, reverse }`
  params: `dur?: seconds = .8` · `ease?: Ease = 'smooth'` · `stagger?: seconds = 0` · `order?: (d, s) => number` · `reverse?: boolean = false`
  e.g. `reveal: { mode: 'rise', order: d => d.props.dist, stagger: .02 }`
- core.render.reveal.define [built]: `reveal.define(name, spec)`
  params: `feature?: (d, p, s) => { opacity?, offset?: [east, north, up] m, scale? }` · `wgsl?: string` (at `/*@reveal*/`, reads `reveal`, `position`, writes `alpha`; translated for WebGL2) · `base?: mode`
  returns: a new mode name
  e.g. `reveal.define('drop-in', { feature: (d, p) => ({ opacity: p, offset: [0, 0, (1 - p) * 300] }) })`
- core.render.reveal.policy [built]: world option `context: 'app' | 'video' = 'app'`
  params: app: a layer that asks for no app mode of its own gets a short fade (at most 0.25 s), no stagger · video: the full reveals (mode, timing, stagger capped so many features never take many seconds) · `reveal: { app: 'radial' }` asks for a rich mode in an app
  e.g. `world(canvas, { context: 'video' })`
- core.render.capture.capture [built]: `w.frame(opts?)` · `w.record(opts)`
  params: frame: `attribution?: boolean | string` (the credits of every layer shown, data included, burned into the bottom right) · record: `fps?: number = 30` (the world's clock steps 1000 / fps ms a frame) · `frames?: int` or `seconds?: number` (unset: until the loop is left) · `size?: [width, height]` (the frame's pixels; unset: the canvas's) · `path?: Keys | Move | (t) => View` (the camera's way: what it will see loads ahead; unset: the move playing) · `ahead?: seconds = 2` · `timeout?: ms = 60000` (a frame's longest wait; past it the frame is taken as it is, said) · `attribution?`
  returns: frame: `Promise<{ width, height, pixels }>` · record: an async iterator of `{ index, t, width, height, pixels, settled, pending, waitedMs }`
  e.g. `for await (const f of w.record({ fps: 30, seconds: 37, path })) encoder.add(f.pixels)`

not there yet (planned, proposed or open; do not use):
  core.render.look.lights, core.render.look.post, core.render.look.cutaway, core.render.style.lens,
  core.render.style.pattern.fill, core.render.style.pattern.stroke, core.render.style.pattern.along,
  core.render.capture.ground-truth

### core.interaction (docs/reference/core/interaction.md)

- core.interaction.picking.picking [built]: `w.pick(x, y, opts?)` · automatic for hover and tap
  params: `x, y: CSS px` · `elements?: string[]` (only these elements; a layer answers for its signs and labels) · `radius?: px = 4` (taps 12)
  returns: `Promise<{ element, id, props, d, index, at: [lon, lat, h], x, y } | null>` (an id pass over a few pixels, the same on WebGPU and WebGL2; the ground hides what is behind it; the top-most layer wins)
  e.g. `const f = await w.pick(e.offsetX, e.offsetY)`
- core.interaction.picking.hover [built]: `hover`, `selected`, `hoverGroup`, `tooltip`, `onHover`, `onTap`, `select` props · world option `tooltip`
  params: `hover?: { color?, mix? = .45, outline?: px, raise?: m, cursor?, shape?: (d, place) => Made | null, material?, follow? } | false` (a 3D form on the hovered thing: your shape for its datum, standing where the thing stands: `place = { at, turn, scale, radius? }`; `material` over the shape's own; `follow`: it moves with a moving thing) · `hoverGroup?: d => key` · `tooltip?: (d, s) => string | HTMLElement` · `onHover?: (f, s) => void` · `onTap?: (f, s) => void` · `select?: 'tap' | 'toggle'`
  returns: — (mouse: hover; touch: a tap shows the tooltip)
  e.g. `streets({ hover: { color: '#ffe066', shape: (d) => d.kind === 'tree' ? crownNet(d.props) : null } })`
- core.interaction.events [built]: `w.on(event, fn)` (returns the function that stops it)
  params: `'hover': (f | null, pointer)` · `'tap': (f | null, { x, y, lon, lat })` · `'select': (ids)` · `'frame'` · `'error'` · `'layers': ({ what, ids })` (a layer added, removed, moved, shown or hidden, faded) (`'load'`, `'settled'`, `'governor'`, `'chunks'` planned)
  returns: an unsubscribe function
  e.g. `w.on('tap', f => f && panel.show(f.props))`
- core.interaction.signals.selection [built]: `w.select(ids)` · `w.toggle(name, on?)` · `s.user` · `selected: { color?, mix?, shape, material, follow }` on a layer · `w.selectedBy(id)`
  params: `ids: (string | number)[] | null` · `name: string` · a solids layer's `selected`: `color?: colour = '#38bdf8'` · `mix?: 0..1 = .65` · `false`: no colour
  returns: `s.user = { hover, selection, toggles, role }` (usable in `when` and styles; layers draw their `selected` look, and a form on each selected thing whose place is known)
  e.g. `when: s => !s.user.selection.length || s.user.selection.includes(d.id)` · `streets({ selected: { color: '#38bdf8' } })`
- core.interaction.controllers [built]: `control(w, layer, target, controller)` · `w.control(target, controller, opts)`
  params: `target: Entity | null` (null = the map; the entity in an entity layer) · `controller: controllers.walk() | ride() | fly() | custom(read)` (an entity) `| orbit({ pan?, rotate?, tilt?, zoom?, zoomRange?: [out, in], tiltRange?: [least, most] }) | pan(o)` (the map: what a person's hands may do; `pan` never turns or tilts) · `opts: { offset?, eye?, blocked? }` (an entity's camera)
  e.g. `control(w, people, me, controllers.walk())`

not there yet (planned, proposed or open; do not use):
  core.interaction.signals.signals, core.interaction.history

### core.entities (docs/reference/core/entities.md)

- core.entities.sets.sets [built]: `entities(options)` · `entity(options)`
  params: moved by data (`drive: drive.data(…)`): `shape?: Made` (drawn near the camera; dots farther) · `near?: { pixels = 12, max = 200, levels?: { full: px = 120, simple: px = 25, margin = .2 }, level?: 0 | 1 | 2 (one pinned), farMax = 4000, size?: { min, max }, scale, turn: s = 1.2, shadow?: true | { opacity = .5, spread = 1.3, fade?: m | false = 6 × its size across, off?: m } }` (the shape's three levels by the pixels each thing covers, kept within the margin; the rest dots) (a soft contact shadow under each shape: one quad each, placed on the chip; in the air on the ground under it, shrunk to half and faded away by `fade` m up, none past `off` m; none by default) · `attitude?: { pitch?: true | value, bank?: true | value, damp: s = 2, max: [deg, deg] = [30, 45], pivot?: [x, y, z] = [0, 0, 0] }` (its shapes turned in the air: pitch from its climb, bank into its turns at its speed (atan(v ω / g)), each the mean over `damp` s of its path either side, banked only off the ground when its log has an altitude (a plane taxiing does not; a motorbike without one leans); or the log's own columns, degrees; `set.attitude(id, t?)` → `{ pitch, bank }` as drawn) · `size?: px | d => px | { value, range, domain } = 7` · `color?: Color | d => Color | { value, ramp, domain }` (a value: its samples' value at the time, on the chip) · `outline?` · `trail?: { seconds = 60, width = 2.5, opacity, color, head, fade: 'linear' | 'ease' | k = 'ease' } | false` · `gauge?: { value, domain, size: [px, px] = [28, 6], colors, outline, lift, within, over: m = 0, label?: true | { size: px, color, halo } } | false` (a bar over each thing filled to a value, its per cent across it ('72%', from a glyph atlas), on the chip) · `joints?: { [part | kind]: { rate, unit } | { formula } | { value, per } }` (its shapes' parts: core › entities › kinematics) · `links?: { to: d => [lon, lat], height?, width?, color?, opacity = .15, focus = 1, pieces = 24 }` (an arc from each thing's place now, read on the chip, to a place of its own: faint, the hovered and selected ones full) · `on?: 'stand' | 'ground' | 'surface' | 'sea' | fn = 'stand'` ('surface': the ground, or the sea's surface where the ground is under it: what a plane flies over) · `lift?: m = .3` · `before?: 'hide' | 'hold'` · `fold?: Relations` (its things held by others for a while: hidden then, every drawing of them, on the chip: core › data › history › relations; a folded thing kept in the near choice: it stands up drawn, the moment its window ends) · `dots?: boolean = true` (false: none: an icon placed on the set draws them) · `tooltip?` · `onTap?` · `select?` · `when?` · `set.track()` (what a thing placed on its things reads on the chip: core › entities › placement); else a shape for each feature: `shape: Shape` · `data: Source` · `params?` · `at?` · `heading?`
  returns: `EntitySet` (one draw for the dots, one for the trails, one for the shapes) · `Entities`
  e.g. `entities({ id: 'fleet', drive: drive.data(log), shape: cars.make({ paint: '#ffffff' }), color: { value: 'charge', ramp: 'rdylgn' } })`
- core.entities.identity.kind [built]: `kind({ name, traits, extends? })` · `kinds.house` · `kinds.office` · `kinds.charger` · `kinds.vehicle` · `shape({ kind })` · `shape.check({ kind })` · `kind.check(made)` · `kind.checkData(props)` · `traits(made, kind, data?)` · `asKind(made, kind, { anchors?, params? })`
  params: a trait: `anchors?: kind` (`'entry'`, `'parking'`, `'service'`, `'seat'`, `'light'`…) · `parts?: prefix` (`'wheel'`, `'door'`) · `measure?: 'footprint' | 'front' | 'roof'` · `param?: name` (with `guess?: made => value` for a model) · `data?: field` with `def?` · `min?: n = 1` · `max?` · `per?: trait` (one per another's: a light per bay) · `where?: 'ground' | 'front' | 'outside' | 'inside' | 'wall' | 'up'` · `optional?`
  returns: `EntityKind` · `{ ok, problems[] }` · the traits by name (anchors, parts, a footprint `{ width, depth, min, max, from }` (the box of the shape's group named `'walls'` when it has one, else of all that stands over 0.3 m: `footprintOf(made)`), a roof `{ surface m², tilt °, top, kind }`, params, data)
  e.g. `kinds.house.check(made).problems` · `traits(typology.house.make({ garage: 'left' }), 'house').parking` · `kind({ name: 'shed', traits: { door: { anchors: 'entry', where: ['ground', 'front'] } } })`
- core.entities.placement.place [partly]: `placement: 'place'` · `place.contents(filter?)` · `place.slots(kind?)`
  params: `footprint?: Area` (from the shape or the data) · `slots?: anchors` (where things go)
  returns: a place: contains things (a building, a station, a park)
  what is there: `entity({ placement: 'place', footprint })` · `place.contents({ kind })`: the things whose place it is; `slots` planned
  e.g. `park.contents({ kind: 'bench' })`
- core.entities.placement.thing [built]: `placement: 'thing'` · `thing.in`
  params: `in?: Place | 'auto' = 'auto'` (the place it sits in, found by position) · `slot?: string`
  returns: a thing: sits in a place (a bench, a lamp, a tree)
  e.g. `bench.in?.data.name`
- core.entities.placement.attach [partly]: `entity.attach(target, anchor, opts)`
  params: `target: Entity` · `anchor: string` · `pose?: string` · `hands?: anchor[]` · `feet?: anchor`
  returns: `Attachment` (`detach()`)
  what is there: a shape at an anchor of every clone, by its name or kind: `entities({ attach: [{ shape: smoke, at: 'stack', params }] })`: the clones' own records, the shape moved to the anchor, its copies over time from there (smoke at every stack's top, WebGPU and WebGL2) …
  e.g. `op.attach(car, 'driver', { pose: 'sit', hands: ['gripL', 'gripR'] })`
- core.entities.locomotion.surface [built]: `locomotion.surface({ on?, … })`
  params: `on?: 'walkable' | Network | Area = 'walkable'` (free, snapped to a network's lines, or held inside an area) · `speed?: m/s = 1.4` · `run?: m/s` · `jump?: m/s` · `blocked?: (lon, lat) => height` (what stands in the way: it stops and slides along) · `wheels?: { top, boost }` (km/h: throttle, brake, steering by speed)
  returns: free on walkable ground, turns on the spot; on wheels, steers
  e.g. `locomotion.surface({ speed: 1.4, blocked: collision(w) })`
- core.entities.locomotion.air [built]: `locomotion.air({ … })` · in a set moved by data: `history.log({ altitude })` with `entities({ attitude })`
  params: `ceiling?: metres = 400` · `speed?: km/h = 40` · `fast?: km/h = 120` · `hover?: boolean = true` · `glide?: 0..1 = .4` (with `hover: false`: the least of its speed it keeps) · `over?: 'ground' | 'sea' = 'ground'` (what its height is over)
  returns: free in three dimensions (a drone, a bird, a plane)
  e.g. `locomotion.air({ ceiling: 120 })` · `locomotion.air({ over: 'sea', hover: false })`
- core.entities.kinematics.hinge [built]: in the build: `b.part(name, fn, { pivot, joint: { kind: 'hinge', axis, limits? } })` · its driver on the layer: `joints: { [name | 'hinge']: driver }` · `layer.joint(name, driver)` · `layer.joint(id, name, driver)` (one clone)
  params: `axis: 'x' | 'y' | 'z' | [x, y, z]` (the shape's frame) · `limits?: [min, max]` (degrees) · a driver: `{ rate, unit?: 'rpm' | 'deg/s' | 'rad/s', phase? }` (the layer's clock; each clone its phase by its seed) | `d => ({ rate })` (each clone its own) | `{ formula }` (statements in the WGSL subset setting `value`, degrees, of `time` and `seed`) | `{ value, per? }` (a set's: its log's value, degrees × per)
  e.g. `b.part('rotor', fn, { pivot: hub, joint: { kind: 'hinge', axis: 'z' } })` · `joints: { rotor: (d) => ({ rate: d.props.rpm, unit: 'rpm' }) }`
- core.entities.kinematics.slider [built]: `b.part(name, fn, { pivot, joint: { kind: 'slider', axis, limits? } })` · `joints: { [name | 'slider']: driver }`
  params: `axis` · `limits?: [min, max]` (metres) · a driver as a hinge's, in metres (`{ rate }` m/s, a formula's `value` m, a log value's m × per)
  e.g. `b.part('boom', fn, { pivot: [0, 3, 0], joint: { kind: 'slider', axis: 'z', limits: [0, 6] } })`
- core.entities.kinematics.wheel [partly]: `b.part(name, fn, { pivot, joint: { kind: 'wheel', axis, radius } })` · `joints: { [name | 'wheel']: driver }`
  params: `radius: m` · a driver as a hinge's, or `{ value: 'travel', per? }` (a set's: it rolls by the metres each thing has gone, kept by its log: `history.log({ travel: true })`) · `steer?` (planned)
  what is there: spun round its axle on the chip by a rate, a formula, or its thing's own travel read between its samples (each wheel's angle its metres ÷ its radius: nothing written per frame); steering by the path's turn planned
  e.g. `joints: { wheel: { value: 'travel' } }`
- core.entities.kinematics.custom [partly]: a joint's value by your formula: `joints: { [name]: { formula } }` · a custom transform: `joint(fn)` (planned)
  params: `formula: string` (statements in the WGSL subset setting `value` (degrees; a slider's metres) of `time` s and `seed` 0..1; the same in both shading languages) · `fn: (value, part) => Transform` (planned)
  returns: `Joint`
  what is there: a formula drives a hinge's, wheel's or slider's value on the chip (its program built once per formulas; until then the layer's own draws it); a transform of your own planned
  e.g. `joints: { arm: { formula: 'value = 30.0 * sin(time * 0.5 + seed * 6.28);' } }`
- core.entities.body.skeleton [built]: `skeleton(spec)` · `entity.bones`
  params: `bones: { name, parent, at }[]` · or a module preset
  returns: `Skeleton`
  e.g. `humans.skeleton('adult')`
- core.entities.body.skin [built]: `skin(mesh, skeleton, opts)`
  params: `weights: 'painted' | 'auto' = 'painted'` · `method?: 'linear' | 'dqs' = 'dqs'`
  returns: a skinned mesh
  e.g. `skin(body, skel, { method: 'dqs' })`
- core.entities.body.morphs [partly]: `entity.morph(name, amount)`
  params: `name: string` · `amount: 0..1`
  what is there: [planned]
  e.g. `op.morph('smile', .6)`
- core.entities.motion.clips [partly]: `clip(name | url)` · `entity.play(clip, opts)`
  params: `loop?: boolean = true` · `speed?: number = 1`
  returns: `Playback`
  what is there: [planned]
  e.g. `op.play('wave', { loop: false })`
- core.entities.motion.gaits [partly]: `entity.go(opts)`
  params: `to: Point | { entity, anchor }` · `gait?: 'walk' | 'run' | 'drive' …` · `path?: 'network' | 'direct' = 'network'`
  returns: `Promise<void>` on arrival
  what is there: [planned]
  e.g. `op.go({ to: { entity: 't-17', anchor: 'service' } })`
- core.entities.motion.blending [partly]: automatic between states; `entity.layer(name, clip, mask)`
  params: `mask?: bone[]` (e.g. the upper body only)
  what is there: [planned]
  e.g. `op.layer('wave', 'wave', ['spine', 'armR'])`
- core.entities.drive.data [built]: `drive.data(source, opts?)`
  params: `source: Log | Source` (a recorded log; a live source, each row's change a sample) · `smooth?: ms = 250` (a live source; 0 for a log: how far the drawing runs behind the data) · `time?: d => t` (default `d.props.t`, else when it arrived) · `values?: Record<name, d => number>` (a log with an altitude: a point's third coordinate, unless its props say) · `log?: LogOptions`
  returns: `DataDrive` (its `log`)
  e.g. `drive.data(data.stream('wss://…/fleet'), { log: { values: { charge: 'u8' } } })`
- core.entities.drive.player [built]: `drive.player(controller)` · `control(w, layer, entity, controller, opts)`
  params: `controller: Controller` (walk, ride, fly; see interaction) · `opts.offset?` (the camera behind) · `opts.eye?: metres` (first person: the camera at its eyes) · `opts.blocked?`
  returns: why it moves: a person controls it (the keys, the touch stick; the view turns by a drag)
  e.g. `control(w, people, me, controllers.walk())`

not there yet (planned, proposed or open; do not use):
  core.entities.sets.crowds, core.entities.identity, core.entities.identity.id, core.entities.identity.data,
