### core.simulation (docs/reference/core/simulation.md)

- core.simulation.fields.raster [built]: `field({ kind: 'raster', … })` · `.step(seconds)` · `.play(rate)` · `.pause()` · `.at(point)` · `.values()` · `.sync()` · `.reset(init)` · `.setParams(p)`
  params: `id: string` · `res: number` (metres a cell) · `area: [w, s, e, n] | { centre, size }` · `init?: number | (lon, lat) => number | grid = 0` · `rule: Rule | Kernel | fn` · `inputs?: Record<name, Field | number | fn | grid | 'terrain'>` · `params?` · `rate?: s/s = 0` · `dt?` (default the rule's stable step) · `draw?: { ramp, domain, opacity, min, channel, on: 'ground' | 'surface', base } | false` · `gpu?: 'auto' | boolean`
  returns: `Field` (a layer)
  e.g. `field({ id: 'flood', res: 3, area: { centre, size: 600 }, rule: rules.shallowWater(), inputs: { ground: 'terrain' } })`
- core.simulation.fields.kernels [built]: `rule: { wgsl, glsl?, cpu?, params?, inputs?, maxDt? }` · `kernel(k)`
  params: `wgsl: string` (sets `next` from `cur`, `dt`, `cell`, your params by name, `laplacian(cur)`, `at(dx, dy)`, `in0…in3(dx, dy)`; the same text serves GLSL when it is expressions only) · `cpu?: (cur, n, dt, p) => number` (where the chip cannot)
  returns: `Rule`
  e.g. `rule: { wgsl: 'next = cur + dt * k * laplacian(cur);', params: { k: .2 }, cpu: (c, n, dt, p) => c + dt * p.k * n.laplacian }`
- core.simulation.rules.presets [built]: `rules.diffusion(o)` · `rules.advection(o)` · `rules.heat(o)` · `rules.shallowWater(o)` · `rules.flow(o)`
  params: diffusion `k` (m²/s) · advection `wind: [u, v] | 'input'` · heat `k`, `relax`, `to: number | 'input'`, `sourceScale` (inputs target, source) · shallowWater / flow `friction`, `gravity`, `rain`, `rainScale`, `openEdges` (inputs ground, rain)
  returns: `Rule` (a WGSL kernel and its GLSL twin, and the CPU path)
  e.g. `rule: rules.diffusion({ k: .2 })`
- core.simulation.rules.custom [built]: `rules.custom(fn, opts?)` · or `rule: fn`
  params: `fn: (cur, n, dt, p) => next` · `n: { laplacian, neighbours: [e, s, w, n], inputs }` · `dt: seconds` · `p: params` · `opts: { params, inputs, maxDt }`
  returns: `Rule` (CPU)
  e.g. `rule: (c, n, dt, p) => c + dt * p.k * n.laplacian`
- core.simulation.measure.probes [built]: `field.probe(opts)` · `field.at(point)`
  params: `at: Point` | `along: Line` | `over: Area` (a ring) · `every?: 'step' | seconds = 'step'`
  returns: `Probe { value, series, stop() }` · `number`
  e.g. `water.probe({ at: [107.61, -6.9] })`
- core.simulation.constants [built]: `constants.load(name)` · `constants.get(path)` · `constants.add(name, table)` · `constants.materials(ids)`
  params: `name: 'materials' | 'physics' | yours` · every value `{ value, unit, source }`
  returns: citable parameter tables (albedo, emissivity, evaporation, heat capacity, conductivity…)
  e.g. `constants.get('materials.asphalt.albedo')`
- core.simulation.phenomena.heat [built]: `heat(options)` · `.run({ input, options, metric })` · `.compare(variantRasters)` · `.point(at)` · `heatModel(rasters).field(input, options)`
  params: `rasters` (placed on the Earth: `{ w, h, cell, mat, materials, bH, cTop, cBase, region, walk, lonLat, xzOf }`) · `input: { hour, weather, day?, sunAt, key }` · `options?: HeatOptions` (each piece of physics on or off) · `metric?: 'utci' | 'feels' | 'tmrt' | 'air' | 'surface' = 'utci'` · `height?: m = 1.1` · `draw?`
  returns: element (a raster field, its street means `summary`)
  e.g. `w.add(heat({ id: 'heat', rasters, input, metric: 'utci' })).run()`

not there yet (planned, proposed or open; do not use):
  core.simulation.agents.behaviour, core.simulation.agents.rhythm, core.simulation.agents.habitat,
  core.simulation.agents.senses, core.simulation.agents.populations, core.simulation.agents.tiers,
  core.simulation.fields.surface, core.simulation.fields.graph, core.simulation.fields.volume,
  core.simulation.rules.coupling, core.simulation.rules.regimes, core.simulation.fidelity.fixed,
  core.simulation.fidelity.observed, core.simulation.measure.sensors, core.simulation.measure.validation,
  core.simulation.phenomena.fluids, core.simulation.phenomena.fire, core.simulation.phenomena.light,
  core.simulation.phenomena.acoustics, core.simulation.phenomena.contacts, core.simulation.phenomena.orbits.ephemerides,
  core.simulation.phenomena.orbits.tle, core.simulation.phenomena.orbits.n-body,
  core.simulation.phenomena.orbits.transfers, core.simulation.phenomena.exchanges, core.simulation.phenomena.growth

### core.world (docs/reference/core/world.md)

- core.world.elements.element [built]: `w.add(...elements)` · `w.remove(id)` · `w.element(id)` · `class X extends Element` (an element: anything added to a world, a mark, a layer, a twin's part, the ground, the sky)
  params: `elements: Element[]` · `id: string`
  returns: `World` · `Element`
  e.g. `w.add(area({ id: 'wkp', data }))`
- core.world.elements.props [partly]: the props every element shares
  params: `id?: string = auto` · `data?: Source` · `when?: When` · `order?: number` · `above?: string` · `below?: string` · `opacity?: number = 1` (a uniform: `w.setOpacity(id, v)`, one frame, nothing built again; `layer.fades` says a layer can) · `label?: string` (its name for people: a layer list) · showing by hand: `w.reveal(id, { seconds })` · `w.hide(id, { seconds })` · `w.release(id, { seconds })` (0: one frame) · `reveal?: Reveal` · `hover?: HoverLook` · `on?: 'ground' | 'sea' | 'seafloor' | 'air' | orbit(…) | 'absolute' = 'ground'` · `height?: Fn<metres>` (negative = below the ground) · `transition?: seconds = 0` (values ease when data changes)
  e.g. `line({ id: 'grid', data, opacity: .8, reveal: { mode: 'trace' } })`
- core.world.elements.order [built]: `order: n` · `above: id` · `below: id` · `w.move(id, to)` · `w.reorder(ids)` (a stack, bottom first: each layer keeps its band, a mark on the ground under the twin's solids, a floating one over them; one frame, nothing built again) · `w.on('elements', f)` (`{ what: 'add' | 'remove' | 'order' | 'shown' | 'opacity' | 'props', ids }`: a layer list keeps in step)
  params: `n: number` · `id: string` · `to: { above? , below?, order? }` · `ids: string[]`
  e.g. `w.move('wind', { below: 'solar' })`
- core.world.settings.params [built]: `w.param(key, spec, set, get?)` · `w.set(key, v)` · `w.get(key)` · `w.params()`
  params: `key: string` (dotted, e.g. `fault.glow`) · `spec: { type: 'number' | 'enum' | 'bool' | 'color' | 'vector' | 'text', range?, options?, default, unit?, describe? }` ('text': a code or a name, e.g. the region a drill-down is in)
  returns: the list of every knob, for editors and assistants
  e.g. `w.param('looks.navy', { type: 'number', range: [0, 1], default: 1 }, v => …)`
- core.world.settings.readouts [built]: `w.readout(key, fn)` · `w.read(key)` · `s.world.readouts`
  params: `fn: () => any` (a live value computed from the world)
  returns: the value
  e.g. `w.readout('buildings.lit', () => lit.count)` · `when: s => s.world.readouts['buildings.lit'] > 0`
- core.world.settings.points [built]: `w.point(name, fn)` · `w.pointAt(name)`
  params: `fn: () => [lon, lat, h?]`
  returns: a named place other parts can aim at (markers, cameras, anchors)
  e.g. `w.point('fault.mid', () => mid)`
- core.world.state.states [built]: `w.capture(opts?)` · `await w.apply(state, opts?)` · `states.diff(a, b)` · `states.validate(json)` · `states.schema` · `states.encode(s)` / `decode(text)` · `states.toURL(s)` / `fromURL(url)` · `w.setTime(t)` · `w.setQuality(q)`
  params: capture: `note?: string` · `layers?: string[]` · `time?: boolean = true` · apply: `seconds?: number` (0 = jump) · `ease?: Ease = 'cinematic'` · `path?: 'direct' | 'arc' | 'around'` · `others?: 'keep' | 'hide' = 'keep'`
  returns: `WorldState` (plain JSON: `{ v: 1, note?, view, time?, observation?, layers: { [id]: { shown?, params?, filter? } }, params?, selection, toggles? }`) · apply: `Promise<{ missing, refused }>` (layers it names that the world has not are reported, never made)
  e.g. `await w.apply(await (await fetch('/answers/burglary')).json(), { seconds: 2.5 })`
- core.world.state.settled [built]: `await w.settled(opts?)`
  params: `strict?: boolean = false` (strict: fails instead of timing out) · `timeout?: ms = 30000` · `hold?: boolean = false` (a paused world settles without moving its clock: only loading is waited for, the moment's motion and reveals stay as they are; captures frame by frame)
  returns: `Promise<boolean>`: every tile, layer and build needed for the current view is in and faded in
  e.g. `await w.settled({ strict: true }); const px = await w.frame(1080, 1920)`
- core.world.describe.schemas [partly]: `schema(kind)`
  params: `kind: string` (`'area'`, `'shape'`, `'world'` …)
  returns: a JSON schema
  what is there: the state schema is built: `states.schema`, `states.validate`; schemas for every element planned
  e.g. `schema('area').properties.color`
- core.world.describe.guide [built]: `docs/authoring.md` · `docs/llms.txt` (also at the examples' site root) · `examples/recipes`
  returns: the authoring guide (one page: the model, your own thing, the rules, a recipe per kind of app, the common mistakes), six complete recipes, every import, the kinds' traits and an index of every part that exists, made from the docs and the tree (`docs/_tree/llms.mjs`; gen.py runs it)
  e.g. `node packages/aslnut/docs/_tree/llms.mjs --check`
- core.world.extend.extend [built]: `class X extends Element { readonly kind; attach(ctx); frame(ctx): DrawCall[]; detach() }`
  params: `ctx.graphics.program({ wgsl, glsl, blocks, vertex?, instance?, textures?, blend?, depth?, cull?, topology? })` · `ctx.graphics.buffer(kind, data)` · `ctx.frame` (the frame block) · `pickInfo(index)` · `placeOf(picked)` · `wantsFrames(s)` (the frames it needs by itself: 0, n a second, Infinity; [the practice](../../concepts/performance.md#building-an-element-frames-and-the-budget)) · `animating()` (its short form)
  returns: a new element kind, on WebGPU and WebGL2
  e.g. `class PulseRing extends Element { … }`
- core.world.extend.hot-swap [partly]: automatic in development; `w.hot(module)`
  params: `module: { shapes?, layers?, rules? }` (a changed file, checked in a worker first)
  returns: swaps by id; the old version stays if the new one fails, with file + line
  e.g. `if (import.meta.hot) import.meta.hot.accept(m => w.hot(m))`
- core.world.lifecycle.world [built]: `world(canvas, options?)`
  params: `canvas: HTMLCanvasElement | null` (null = headless: Node, servers, tests, the same results) · `body?: Body = earth()` · `bodies?: Body[]` · `view?: View` · `time?: Date | 'now' = 'now'` · `graphics?: 'auto' | 'webgpu' | 'webgl2' = 'auto'` · `render?: { quality, shadows?: boolean | ShadowOptions }` (`'auto'`: the device's quality; shadows off by default, cast by the light of a `sky()`) · `timeZone?: string | 'auto'` (the clocks' zone: `s.time.local`) · `clock?: 'real' | { fps }` · `attribution?: false | { position, format }` · `onError?: (e) => void` · `pixelRatio?: number` · `budget?: Budget | 'auto' | false = 'auto'` · `frames?: FramesOptions` (draw on demand) · `loader?: LoaderOptions` · `build?: 'auto' | 'compiled' | 'live' = 'auto'` · `seed?: number` (planned: same seed, same world; a shape's builds take their own seed) · `theme?: Theme` (an analysis view: core › render › style › theme)
  returns: `Promise<World>`
  e.g. `const w = await world(canvas, { body: earth() })`
- core.world.lifecycle.errors [built]: `AslnutError`
  params: `code: string` · `message: string` · `fix?: string` · `where?: string`
  returns: thrown
  e.g. `catch (e) { if (e.code === 'E-GPU-001') showUnsupported() }`
- core.world.lifecycle.dispose [built]: `w.dispose()`
  returns: `void` (stops the clock, ends workers and streams, frees GPU memory)
  e.g. `onUnmount(() => w.dispose())`
- core.world.host.plain [built]: ES module, no framework
  e.g. `import { world } from 'aslnut'`
- core.world.host.react [built]: `import { World, useWorld, useElement, useWorldEvent } from 'aslnut/react'` · `<World options elements onReady viewChange headless className style>{children}</World>` (made on mount on a canvas of its own, `world(canvas, options)`; disposed on unmount; strict-mode safe; on a server an empty box) · `useWorld()` (the world from context; null until ready) · `useElement(id, w?)` (null until added) · `useWorldEvent(name, fn, w?)` (`w.on(name, fn)` while mounted) · the same diff without React: `shell(w, { options }).elements(list)` · `.options(o, viewChange?)` (from `'aslnut'`)
  params: `options?: WorldOptions` (made with these; later the ones with a setter follow by value: `views`, `time`, `timeZone`, `quality`, `render.shadows`, `theme`, `budget`, `priorities`, `observation`; the rest are the world's for its life: a new `key` makes a new world) · `elements?: Element[]` (aslnut's own objects, made in render, each with an `id`: a new id → `w.add`, a gone one → `w.remove`, a changed prop → `element.setProps` on the one in the world, never made again; another kind under an id is made anew; values compared by value, functions and sources by identity; the list's order is the add order, the stack is a prop: `order`, `above`, `below`) · `onReady?: (w) => void` (once per world, its elements in) · `viewChange?: 'go' | 'fly' | FlyOptions` (a changed `options.view` moves the camera; unset: it stays the person's) · `headless?: boolean` (`world(null)`: an app's tests)
  returns: a React element: a `position: relative` box, the canvas filling it, the children over it
  e.g. `<World options={{ body: plane() }} elements={[layer({ id: 'zones', data, area: { color: dark ? A : B } })]} onReady={(w) => replay(w, { log, play: true })} />`
- core.world.host.server-safe [built]: imports never touch `window`, `document` or the graphics chip
  e.g. `import { describe } from 'aslnut'` in Node
- core.world.host.package [built]: `import … from 'aslnut'` · `'aslnut/core/…'` · `'aslnut/modules/world/earth'` · `'aslnut/react'`
  params: ES modules + types · one entry per part (subpath exports) · `sideEffects: false` · code only, never data (`earth-lite` comes from a URL, see [hosting](../../concepts/hosting.md))
  e.g. `import { world } from 'aslnut'; import { earth } from 'aslnut/modules/world/earth'`

not there yet (planned, proposed or open; do not use):
  core.world.state.json, core.world.describe.describe, core.world.extend.provide, core.world.host.canvases,
  core.world.host.zebflow

### core.runtime (docs/reference/core/runtime.md)

- core.runtime.frame [built]: automatic (draw on demand) · `world(canvas, { frames })` · `w.everyFrame(fn, o)` · a layer's `wantsFrames(s)`
  params: `frames.max?: number` (the most frames a second any one animation gets; default every display frame) · `frames.rate?: (layer, wants, s) => number` (your rule: lower a layer's rate, or 0 to freeze it) · `frames.rest?: ms | false = 500` (stillness after motion before the loop rests; after a change of its own on a still, settled view, a layer shown or faded, it rests at the next frame: one frame drawn, two asked) · `frames.light?: ms = 60000` (time 'now': a look at the light) · everyFrame: `fn: (s, dt) => void` · `fps?: number = every frame` (0: none asked) · `budgetMs?: number = 1` · `before?: boolean = false` (run before the frame is drawn, after the clock moved and before the camera's own update: a camera set there is this frame's, not the next one's)
  returns: everyFrame: the function that turns it off · `wantsFrames`: 0 none, Infinity every display frame, n a second
  e.g. `w.everyFrame((s, dt) => hud.update(s), { fps: 10 })`
- core.runtime.detail.detail [built]: automatic; `detail: { error, levels }` per element · a shape's levels by the pixels it covers: `solids({ pixels: { full, simple, margin } })`, `entities({ pixels })`, a set's `near: { levels: { full, simple, margin } }` (or one pinned: `level`) · `keptLevel(v, prev, a, b, 1 + margin, byDistance)`
  params: `error?: number = 2` (pixels of allowed error) · `levels?: LevelRules` · `margin?: share = .2` (a level changes only past its edge by this share of it; the eye moving a few metres is the dwell)
  returns: the level of detail per tile or object: coarse first, never a hole, never a visible change of look or colour (a shape's simpler version, a coarser tile; never what is shown: that is the observation level)
  e.g. `earth({ detail: { error: 1.5 } })`
- core.runtime.detail.priorities [built]: `world(canvas, { priorities })` · `w.setPriorities(p)`
  params: `drop?: string[]` (first dropped first: a rung of the world's ('detail', 'shadows', 'quality', 'resolution') or an element by id: its own detail ¾, ½, ¼ (coarser levels sooner, fewer copies over time; never hidden: that is your call, on the governor's event)) · `keep?: string[]` (never dropped: a kept element draws at full detail whatever the world's; a kept rung is never taken)
  e.g. `priorities: { drop: ['smoke', 'shadows'], keep: ['fleet', 'labels'] }`
- core.runtime.detail.prefetch [built]: `w.prefetch(views, opts)` · automatic for a flight's end (`w.fly`), camera keys and moves of a second or more (`w.play`) and a recording's way (`w.record({ path })`)
  params: `views: (View | name | Pose)[]` · `depth?: int = 1` (coarser levels loaded first) · `timeout?: ms = 30000`
  returns: `Promise<{ needed, have }>` (the tiles in)
  e.g. `await w.prefetch(['city', 'port'])`
- core.runtime.budget.budget [built]: `world(canvas, { budget })` · `w.setBudget(b | null)` · `w.governor` (the budget, what is dropped)
  params: `'auto'` (the default: the device's, `{ frameMs: 22 }` on phones, tablets and low tiers, none elsewhere) · `false` (none) · or yours: `frameMs?: number` (ms between frames; over at 1.5 ×) · `memoryMB?: number` (graphics memory) · `triangles?: number` · `drawCalls?: number` (each unset one is not measured; no budget: no governor)
  e.g. `budget: { frameMs: 33, memoryMB: 400 }`
- core.runtime.budget.governor [built]: automatic with a budget; `world(canvas, { governor })` · `w.on('governor', f)`
  params: `stepDownAfter?: frames = 10` · `stepUpAfter?: frames = 120` (twice as long each time a step up is soon undone) · `ladder?: { name, down(), up() }[]` (default: detail first, ¾ and ½ (`s.render.detail`: coarser ground tiles, nearer levels of detail), the sun's shadow map half, a quarter, off, quality lite, and only then the pixel ratio, by quarters down to `resolution.floor` (default 1.5, or the screen's when less), the picture smoothed by FXAA while it is cut (`resolution.antialias`: `'auto'` the default, `true` every frame, `false` never)) · `false`: measured, never stepped
  returns: events `{ step: 'down' | 'up', dropped: string[], why }`
  e.g. `w.on('governor', e => log(e.dropped))`
- core.runtime.budget.memory [built]: `world(canvas, { memory: { limitMB, evict } })` · `loader.setMemory(bytes, evict)`
  params: `limitMB?: number` (default from the device's memory, 192 at most) · `evict?: 'least-seen' | ({ key, bytes, seenMsAgo }) => number = 'least-seen'` (the lowest score out first)
  e.g. `memory: { limitMB: 350 }`
- core.runtime.workers.workers [built]: `workers.worker(module, opts)` · `lane.call(name, ...args)` · `lane.callIn(at, name, ...args)` (in that worker: what your module keeps there, a cache, kept once) · `workers.serve(fns)` (in the worker) · `heavy: true` on layers
  params: `module: URL | () => Worker` · `count?: int = cores − 2 (1 … 4)` · `transfer?: boolean = true` · `fallback?: Record<name, fn>` (the main thread's, where workers cannot run)
  returns: `WorkerLane` with `call(name, ...args)`
  e.g. `const tiles = lanes.worker(() => new Worker(new URL('./tiles.worker.ts', import.meta.url), { type: 'module' }))`
- core.runtime.workers.compile [partly]: runs on the authoring machine (studio after save, command line, compile page) · `compile(opts)`
  params: see [tools › compile](../tools.md) · `workers?: int = cores`
  returns: `Promise<Manifest>`
  what is there: [planned]
  e.g. `await compile({ inputs, out: './compiled' })`
- core.runtime.telemetry.telemetry [built]: `w.telemetry()` · the observation panel · `g.memory()` (a graphics' holdings by label)
  returns: `{ frameMs, frameP95, cpuMs, gpuMs, draws, triangles, memoryMB, tiles, loading, dropped, budget, quality: { now, auto, tier, why }, frames: { fps, wants, who, resting, restedMs }, elements: [{ id, draws, triangles, ms, gpuMB, wants }], memory: [{ id, MB }] }`
  e.g. `panel.show(w.telemetry())`
- core.runtime.telemetry.remote-log [built]: `world(canvas, { log: url | options })` · `w.log(ev, data)`
  params: `url: string` (takes POSTed JSON lines) · `level?: 'warn' | 'info' = 'warn'` (warn: errors, the governor's steps, frames over 100 ms; info: and a heartbeat a second (frame times p50 / p95, draws, tiles, pixel ratio, graphics MB, what is dropped), long frames, your events) · `fields?: object | () => object` (on every line) · `every?: ms = 2000` (batched) · `send?: (url, body) => void`
  returns: events from phones reach your machine
  e.g. `world(canvas, { log: { url: '/api/log', level: 'info', fields: { page: 'city' } } })`

not there yet (planned, proposed or open; do not use):
  core.runtime.workers.servers, core.runtime.partners.external-engine, core.runtime.partners.fmi,
  core.runtime.partners.experiment, core.runtime.telemetry.shots

### modules.world (docs/reference/modules/world.md)

- modules.world.surface.tiles [built]: automatic for every body with a surface
  params: `error?: number = 2` (pixels) · `maxZoom?: int = 19` · `skirts?: boolean = true`
  returns: a screen-size quadtree of tiles, parents kept while children load; its texture pools by need (Law 13): the imagery pool from 32 layers (256 kB each), grown in steps of 16 when a view needs more tiles than it holds with room to spare (0.6 of them), its layers copied over (nothing loaded again); the draped marks' overlay pool (512 × 512 …
  e.g. `earth({ surface: { error: 1.5 } })`
- modules.world.surface.imagery [built]: `imagery: Imagery[]` on a body
  params: list of providers · per item `where?: Area` · `when?: When` · `opacity?: number = 1` · `blend?`
  e.g. `earth({ imagery: [imagery.esri(), imagery.xyz(url, { where: city })] })`
- modules.world.surface.terrain [built]: `terrain: Terrain[]` on a body
  params: list of providers · `exaggerate?: Fn<number> = 1` · per item `where?` · `blend?: metres`
  e.g. `earth({ terrain: [terrain.mapzen(), terrain.grid({ url, where })] })`
- modules.world.surface.street-detail [built]: `streetDetail({ url, build })` · `streets({ url })` (earth)
  params: `street?: { kerbs, markings, furniture } | false`
  returns: street-level detail added only when near
  e.g. `world(canvas, { street: { furniture: false } })`
- modules.world.surface.sky [built]: `new Sky(props?)` (added by the body)
  params: `space?: rgb` · `glow?: rgb` (round the globe) · `horizon?, zenith?: rgb` (over the flat map) · `stars?: number`
  returns: one full-screen pass behind the surface: space, stars and the glow round the globe; a horizon-to-zenith sky over the flat map
  e.g. `new Sky({ stars: .6 })`
- modules.world.plane [built]: `plane(options)`
  params: `size?: number = 1000` (metres) · `grid?: number | false = 10` · `color?: color = '#eee'` · `units?: 'm' = 'm'`
  returns: `Body` (flat, no curvature)
  e.g. `world(canvas, { body: plane({ size: 50 }) })`

not there yet (planned, proposed or open; do not use):
  modules.world.shared, modules.world.surface.provenance, modules.world.sun, modules.world.moon, modules.world.mars

### modules.world.earth (docs/reference/modules/earth.md)

- modules.world.earth.shared [partly]: `earth/shared`: helpers every earth part uses (OSM tags, Overture schemas, projections)
  what is there: [planned]
  e.g. `import { osmTags } from 'aslnut/modules/world/earth/shared'`
- modules.world.earth.body.earth [built]: `earth(options?)`
  params: `imagery?: Imagery[] = [imagery.esri()]` (a list, painted in order) · `terrain?: Terrain[] = [terrain.mapzen()]` (a list; `[]` = flat) · `exaggerate?: Fn<number> = 1` (may change with the observation level or time; never with the camera) · `sea?: Sea` (see `water/sea/level`) · `base?: Imagery | null` (an offline basemap always under the imagery: `earthLite({ url })`) · `sky?: boolean | SkyProps | Element` (default a plain sky; `sky()` the real sun and moon for the place and time, their light and shadows; `false` none) · `surface?` (the ground's grade, shade)
  returns: `Body`
  e.g. `earth({ imagery: [imagery.esri()], terrain: [terrain.mapzen()], exaggerate: s => s.observation.index < 3 ? 8 : 1.5 })`
- modules.world.earth.body.base.imagery.esri [built]: `imagery.esri(opts?)`
  params: `layer?: 'world-imagery' | 'topo' | 'streets' | 'light' | 'dark' = 'world-imagery'` ('light': the Light Gray Canvas a GIS view sits on, tiles to level 16) · `url?: string` · `token?: string` · `when?` · `opacity?`
  returns: `Imagery` (terms included)
  e.g. `imagery.esri()`
- modules.world.earth.body.base.imagery.osm [built]: `imagery.osm(opts?)`
  params: `url?: string` (a tile server; the public one allows light use only)
  returns: `Imagery`
  e.g. `imagery.osm({ url: myTiles })`
- modules.world.earth.body.base.imagery.sentinel [built]: `imagery.sentinel(opts?)`
  params: `year?: 2018 … 2024 = 2020`
  returns: `Imagery` (EOX Sentinel-2 cloudless, CC BY 4.0: free to keep, prefetch and export, with attribution)
  e.g. `imagery.sentinel({ when: { level: { to: 'region' } } })`
- modules.world.earth.body.base.imagery.custom [built]: `imagery.custom(spec)`
  params: `id` · `url? | draw?: (ctx, tile) => void` · `attribution` · `terms?`
  returns: `Imagery`
  e.g. `imagery.custom({ id: 'ortho', url, attribution: '© Kota Bandung' })`
- modules.world.earth.body.base.terrain.mapzen [built]: `terrain.mapzen(opts?)`
  params: `max?: int = 15`
  returns: `Terrain` (AWS Terrarium tiles; includes the seafloor, negative heights)
  e.g. `terrain.mapzen()`
- modules.world.earth.body.base.terrain.grid [built]: `terrain.grid(opts)`
  params: `url: string` (a GeoTIFF or grid pack) · `where?: Area` · `when?` · `blend?: metres = 50`
  returns: `Terrain`
  e.g. `terrain.grid({ url: '/dem/bandung.tif', where: city })`
- modules.world.earth.body.base.terrain.custom [built]: `terrain.custom(spec)`
  params: `id` · `heights: (tile, n) => Float32Array` · `attribution?`
  returns: `Terrain`
  e.g. `terrain.custom({ id: 'my-dem', heights })`
- modules.world.earth.body.base.offline [built]: `earth.offline(opts)`
  params: `pack: url` (a small world pack: coarse imagery, terrain, coasts, names)
  returns: `Body` options that never touch the network
  e.g. `earth(earth.offline({ pack: '/earth-lite' }))`
- modules.world.earth.air.atmosphere.scattering [built]: `sky({ weather: { turbidity } })`
  params: `atmosphere?: boolean | { density, turbidity = 2 } = true`
  e.g. `sky({ atmosphere: { turbidity: 4 } })`
- modules.world.earth.air.atmosphere.haze [built]: `sky({ haze })` · `sky({ dim })`
  params: `level?: number = 1` · `base?: metres` · `height?: metres = 600` · `clear?: number` · dim: `amount: 0..1 | s => 0..1` · `color?: string = '#151c28'` · `seconds?: number = 1`
  e.g. `sky({ haze: { level: .6, base: 700 } })` · `sky({ dim: { amount: s => s.user.toggles.analysis ? 1 : 0 } })`
- modules.world.earth.air.atmosphere.clouds [built]: `sky({ clouds })`
  params: `cover` (the weather's) · `base?: metres = 2700` · `shadows?: boolean = true` · `source?: RasterSource` · `zoom?: int = 6`
  returns: element
  e.g. `sky({ clouds: { base: 1800 } })`
- modules.world.earth.air.weather.presets [built]: `sky({ weather })` · `sky.setWeather(name | mix, { seconds })` · `WEATHERS`
  params: `name: 'clear' | 'partly' | 'overcast' | 'drizzle' | 'rain' | 'storm' | 'fog'` · or a mix `{ cover, overcast, rain, turbidity, fog, wind, lightning }` · `seconds?: number` (eased)
  e.g. `sky.setWeather('rain', { seconds: 4 })`
- modules.world.earth.air.weather.wind [built]: `sky({ weather: { wind } })` · `w.light.wind` · `sky.feed({ data, wind, rain, visibility, cover, every, seconds })` · `openMeteo.current(points)`
  params: `wind: m/s` (or a feed's field)
  returns: the wind others can read (`w.light.wind`; the frame's)
  e.g. `sky({ weather: { wind: 12 } })`
- modules.world.earth.air.weather.rain [built]: `rain(options)` · `sky({ weather: { rain } })` · `sky.feed({ data, rain })`
  params: `amount?: number | s => number` (the sky's rain by default) · `count?` · `box?` · `ceiling?`
  returns: falling rain round the eye, wet surfaces (darker, gleaming)
  e.g. `w.add(rain())`
- modules.world.earth.air.weather.fog [built]: `sky({ weather: { fog } })` · `w.light.visibility` · `sky.feed({ data, visibility })`
  params: `fog: number` (thickness) → visibility, metres
  e.g. `sky.setWeather('fog')`
- modules.world.earth.water.hydrology.water [built]: `water(options)` · `waterArea(mb, ring, look)` · `stream(mb, pts, width, look)` · `widthOf(props)` · a layer's `sea(s)`
  params: `rivers?: Source` (lines) · `lakes?: Source` (polygons) · `width?: d => m` (default its width, else by kind: river 20, canal 12, creek 4, drain 3) · `sea?: boolean = true` · `level?: Fn<metres> = 0` (a number or your function of the state: a tide) · `near?: m = 8000` (lakes and rivers drawn while the camera is nearer; the sea at every distance) · `look?: { water, stream, sea }`
  returns: element
  e.g. `water({ rivers: osm.waterways, lakes: osm.water, sea: true })`
- modules.world.earth.water.sea.shore [built]: `sea({ shore })` · `coastSegments(features, at, box?)` · `coastField(segs, grid, band)` · `localFrame(origin)` · `SHORE`
  params: `coast: Source | Feature[]` (lines with the land on their left, as OpenStreetMap's `natural=coastline` runs; or polygons of land, either way round) · `surf?: m = 120` (where the waves break) · `runup?: m = 12` (how far up the sand they run, each wave its share) · `period?: Fn<s> = 9` (between waves) · `foam?: 0..1 = 1` · `shelf?: m/m = 0.02` (the floor's fall from the coast: the waves slow by it, the water's depth near the coast by it) · `cell?: m = 2` (the field's finest)
  returns: the shore drawn by the ground's sea and the sea's own surface alike: the coast's signed distance (+ at sea, − on land) in a field of 1,024² cells round the eye, within the surf zone's band, made once a window a slice a frame (a new window as the eye moves away, cells coarser higher up: none past a third of the band a cell) …
  e.g. `sea({ shore: { coast: data.geojson('/coast.geojson'), surf: 140, runup: 14, period: 11 } })`
- modules.world.earth.water.sea.look [built]: `sea(options)` (a layer that gives the world its sea, over `water()`'s plain one) · `sea({ look })` · `waveSet({ speed, from, swell?, count? })` · `SEA_LOOK`
  params: `level?: Fn<m> = 0` · `look?: true | { shallow?: color = '#2fb3ad', deep?: color = '#0b3a57', clarity?: m = 9` (the depth it turns deep over) · `wind?: { speed?: Fn<m/s>` (default the sky's weather, else 6) `, from?: Fn<degrees> = 225 }` · `swell?: { height, period, from } | false` · `glitter?: 0..2 = 1` · `waves?: int = 16` · `tier?: 'auto' | 'flat' | 'displaced' = 'auto'` · `reach?: × eye height = 300` (the displaced surface's) · `clock?: s => seconds` (the waves' own time: default the world's clock) `}`
  returns: the sea's look at every zoom: a sum of directional waves the wind raises (Pierson and Moskowitz's sea for its speed, spread round its way, the longest first; a swell when given), their phases written once a frame at the view's centre (a frame of the ground: the waves stay put as the eye moves), the water shallow to deep by its depth (the terrain's floor …
  e.g. `w.add(sea({ look: { wind: { speed: 6, from: 120 }, swell: { height: 1.3, period: 12, from: 225 } }, shore: { coast } }))`
- modules.world.earth.air.sky.sun [built]: `earth({ sky: sky({ sun }) })` · `w.read('sky.sun')` · `w.light`
  params: `sun?: boolean = true`
  returns: `{ azimuth, altitude, color }` for the place and time
  e.g. `s.world.sun.altitude > 0`
- modules.world.earth.air.sky.moon [built]: `sky({ moon })` · `w.read('sky.moon')`
  params: `moon?: boolean = true`
  returns: `{ azimuth, altitude, phase }`
  e.g. `when: s => s.world.moon.phase > .9`
- modules.world.earth.air.sky.stars [built]: `sky({ stars })` · `sky().stars(opts)` · `catalogues.hipparcos({ url? })` · `catalogues.custom({ load, attribution? })` · `parseStars(text)` · `skyTurn(t, lon, lat)`
  params: `stars?: false | number` (a made-up field, its brightness: nothing loaded) `| { magnitude?: number = 6, catalogue?: Catalogue = catalogues.hipparcos(), brightness?: 0..1 = 1, size?: px = 3 }` · hipparcos `url?` (a list you host: ra, dec, magnitude, B−V, tab-separated; `tools/stars-pack.mjs` makes one)
  e.g. `sky({ stars: { magnitude: 5 } })` · `sky({ stars: { catalogue: catalogues.hipparcos({ url: '/packs/sky/hipparcos.tsv' }) } })`
- modules.world.earth.climate.heat [built]: `cityHeat(tiles, options)` · `cityRasters(tiles, { centre, size, cell, changes })` · `heatRaster(r, grid, { domain })`
  params: `tiles`: the street level's · `centre` · `size?: metres = 360` · `cell?: metres = 2` · `changes?: { streetTrees, coolRoads, wateredGrass }` · `input` · `metric?`
  returns: a heat element (core › simulation › phenomena › heat) over the street level · its rasters · a raster source
  e.g. `w.add(cityHeat(street.tiles(), { centre, input })).run()`
- modules.world.earth.presets.built.roads.sections [built]: `roads(options)` · `r.sections()` · `r.junctions()` · `r.network()` · `sectionMesh(mb, section)` · `junctionMesh(mb, junction)`
  params: `data: Source` (centre lines with OSM-style tags: highway, lanes, width, sidewalk, sidewalk:width, oneway; `nodes` when known) · `keep?: d => boolean` (default: a road's highway) · `cls?: d => class` · `section?: (d, profile) => Profile` (your last word; from OSM tags by default) · `rules?: ProfileRules = VIC_STREETS` · `junctions?: { radius, crossings }` · `solve?: boolean = true` (fit to the terrain at every vertex; false: each piece at its middle's ground) · `look?`
  returns: element + a road network

### modules.presets.humans (docs/reference/modules/human.md)

  params: person: `age?: 'child' | 'teen' | 'adult' | 'elder'` · `presentation?: 'fem' | 'masc'` · `skin?` · `hair?` · `hairColor?` · `outfit?` · `gait?` · `emotion?` · `body?` (sliders) · `garments?: boolean = true` · crowd: `template: Template | () => Promise<Template>` · `network: () => Network | null` (the walking network) · `around: () => [lon, lat]` (where they stay) · `count?: int = 24` · `figures?: int = 8` (distinct figures) · `radius?: m = 220` · `seed?` · `people?: (i) => Person`

### kits.dashboard (docs/reference/kits/dashboard.md)

- kits.dashboard.legend [built]: `legend(w, options)` · `legend(null, { for: scale }).describe()`
  params: `for: string | Scale` (a layer id: its `color` scale; or a scale) · `title?: string` · `position?: Corner = 'bottom-left'` · `format?: (v) => string` · `into?: HTMLElement` · `className?: string` · `prop?: string = 'color'`
  returns: `{ el, describe(), update(), remove() }` (drawn for you and kept up to date with the data; or described for your own UI)
  e.g. `legend(w, { for: 'crime', title: 'per 1,000' })`
- kits.dashboard.cards [built]: `cards(options)` (a data card on each thing or feature, still or moving) · `c.valuesOf(i, t?)` (what an item's card shows at a time) · `c.decisions()` (each card's collision now, read back: the tools')
  params: `of: id | Element | Source | array` (a set's moving things, by reference; a layer's or an instance set's features; a source, a group's) · `log?: Log` (what a value named by a string reads; default the set's own, a group's) · `icons?: IconAtlas` (marks › symbols › icon) · `header?: { icon?: Fn<string>, text?: Fn<string> }` · `rows?: { label, value: Channel, of?: Channel ('3/4'), decimals?: 0 | 1 | 2, bar?: true | { domain } }[]` or `{ label, text: d => string }` (its item's own text in the value's place) (six at most) · `fill?: { value: Channel, color: v => Color (any scale of the value), domain? }` · `badge?: { value: Channel, when?: (v, d) => boolean = v > 0 }` · `size?: px | { px | m, min, max } = 120` (its width: the one size rule; its layout scales with it) · `fit?: boolean | { min = 0.5, max = 2 }` (each card as wide as its header and rows need, within shares of its size: a long name whole, a short one narrower) · `collide?: boolean | { cover = 0.35, hold = 0.6, away = 1.5, fade = 0.35 } = true` · `priority?: d => number` · `lift?: m | d => m` · `at?` · `look?: { background, ink, inkOnDark, bar, badge, radius, dots = true }` (neutral: a white card, dark ink) · `tooltip?` · `onTap?` · `select?` · `when?`. A channel (core › data › history › channels): a number · `d => number` (each item's own) · `'name'` (the log's value) · `{ value, log?: Log | d => Log, key?: d => id | id[] }` (another log's, by key; several summed) · `relations.count` (the members a host holds) · `relations.members('sum' | 'mean' | 'min' | 'max', value, log?)` (an aggregate of what its members carry while it holds them) · `{ formula: (v, d) => number, inputs? }` (of the others, and of channels of its own)
  returns: element
  e.g. `cards({ of: 'stations', log: ports, icons: pics, header: { icon: 'station', text: d => d.props.name }, rows: [{ label: 'in use', value: { value: 'busy', key: portsOf }, of: d => d.props.ports, bar: true }], fill: { value: 'net', color: scale.linear(v => v, { domain: [-100, 100], range: 'rdbu' }) }, badge: { value: plugged.count } })`
- kits.dashboard.stats [built]: `stats(options)` · `st.setOptions(p)` · `st.ranked(order?)` · `st.total`
  params: `areas: Source` · `of?: Source` (counted where each feature's middle lies) · `filter?: Filter` · `count? | sum? | mean?: prop | fn` · `value?: prop | (area, agg) => number` (the area's own number) · `per?: 'km2' | 'none' | prop | fn` · `scale?: number` (1000: per 1,000)
  returns: `Stats` (a source of rows `{ id, name, value, raw, count, area_km2, rank, share }`; live when its inputs or options change)
  e.g. `stats({ areas: suburbs, of: parks, filter: { group: 'park' }, sum: 'ha', per: 'pop', scale: 1000 })`
- kits.dashboard.layers [built]: the layer list, a panel over core › encoding › layers: `layers(w, options)` · `.describe()` · `.show(id, on)` · `.setOpacity(id, v)` · `.restack(group, idsTopFirst)` · `.fold()`
  params: `groups?: Record<string, (Element | string | LayerPart)[]>` (named groups in this order: the twin's own parts apart from the data; a `LayerPart` is something switched that is not an element: `{ id, label, shown(), show(on), note?, radio? }`, the terrain's relief, a kind a layer builds; parts with the same `radio` name: one choice, drawn as radio buttons (a base map)) · `of?: (Element | string)[]` (when no group names them; default every layer and element with a `label`) · `title?: string = 'Layers'` · `position?: Corner = 'top-right'` · `opacity?: boolean = true` · `reorder?: boolean = true` (drag a row's grip within its group) · `legend?: boolean = true` (its scale's classes, or a swatch) · `legends?: Record<id, Legend | Scale>` · `modes?: boolean = false` (where each layer sits, tapped to change: builds its programs again) · `fade?: seconds = 0` · `folded?: boolean` (default: under 600 px) · `into?: HTMLElement` · `className?: string` · `add?: boolean | { group?, services?: string[], make?: (pick) => Element, headers?, fetch?, proxy? } = false` (an 'add a layer' form: a WMS or WFS URL, its layers listed from its capabilities, one picked: a WMS layer as one picture of the view at .7 opacity, a WFS layer as areas, lines or points by its geometry (DescribeFeatureType), loaded once: the whole layer when small, else the view's box when added, into `group`)
  returns: `{ el, describe(), update(), remove(), show, setOpacity, restack, fold, listService(url, kind?), addFrom(pick) }` (a panel that folds to one button on a phone, rows of 44 px; kept in step with `w.add` / `w.remove` and with what is shown (its level, a toggle) through `w.on('elements')`; `describe()`: `{ title, groups: [{ name, items: [{ id, label, kind` …
  e.g. `layers(w, { groups: { Data: ['suburbs', 'routes', 'stops'], Twin: [relief, 'roads', 'water'] } })`

### kits.game (docs/reference/kits/game.md)

- kits.game.avatars [built]: `avatars(w, options)` · `.setMode('walk' | 'car' | 'drone' | 'map')` · `.setCamera('follow' | 'first-person')` (V, or ◉ on a phone) · `.me` (the entity)
  params: `start?: at => { at, heading }` (a street near) · `obstacle?: (lon, lat) => height` · `touch?: boolean` (a stick, ▲ ▼) · `shapes?: { walker: stride => Made, car: () => Made, drone: () => Made }` (yours, from shape(...); made when first needed) · `colors?` (the plain ones) · `vehicles?: { near, onEnter, onExit }` (get in at a vehicle's entry or driver anchor with F or ⇄, out beside it, left parked) · `camera?: 'follow' | 'first-person'`
  returns: the camera behind it, under control
  e.g. `avatars(w, { obstacle, shapes: { car: () => car.make() } }).setMode('walk')`
- kits.game.collision [built]: `collision(w, options)`
  params: `solids?: 'compiled' | Source | Feature[] = 'compiled'` (the world's layers that answer `blockerAt`: the street level's buildings; or your polygons) · `height?: f => m` · `radius?: number = .3` · `step?: number = .35` (metres you can step over)
  returns: `(lon, lat) => height` (0: open)
  e.g. `locomotion.surface({ blocked: collision(w, { radius: .3 }) })`

### kits.authoring (docs/reference/kits/authoring.md)


not there yet (planned, proposed or open; do not use):
  kits.authoring.networks, kits.authoring.zones, kits.authoring.rules, kits.authoring.terraform, kits.authoring.diffs,
  kits.authoring.pieces

### tools (docs/reference/tools.md)

- tools.bake [partly]: `bake.pack(opts)` · `bake.tiles(opts)` · `bake.pmtiles(opts)` · `aslnut bake …`
  params: `inputs: string[]` · `out: string` · `views?: View[]` (what to include)
  returns: packs, mesh tiles, PMTiles
  what is there: [planned] (a research prototype exists)
  e.g. `aslnut bake pack --views ./views.json --out ./packs/bandung`
- tools.compile.run.command [built]: `aslnut compile <project> --out <dir>`
  params: `--only <steps>` · `--changed` (only stale chunks) · `--workers <n>`
  returns: exit code; manifest written last
  e.g. `aslnut compile ./my-city --out ./compiled --changed`
- tools.compile.inputs [partly]: `compile({ inputs })`
  params: `authored: dir` · `raw?: { osm?, dem?, footprints? }` (never modified) · `shapes?: dir` · `terrain?: Terrain[]`
  what is there: roads: OSM ways as GeoJSON with node ids and tags, a ground grid
  e.g. `inputs: { authored: './authored', raw: { dem: './dem.tif' } }`
- tools.compile.steps.solve [partly]: step `solve`
  params: `terraform?: boolean = true`
  returns: terrain + roads, rails, rivers fitted to it
  what is there: roads, in three stages: the line graph with its heights; the polygons (buffers unioned per level, corners closed, slivers dropped, junction zones); the kerb last; bridges, tunnels, islands, markings, the clamp
  e.g. `steps: { only: ['solve', 'resolve'] }`
- tools.compile.steps.manifest [partly]: step `manifest` (always last)
  returns: `manifest.json`: version, input hashes, chunk ids and hashes
  what is there: roads: `index.json` with the kinds, sources, licences and the checks' report
  e.g. (always)
- tools.compile.outputs [partly]: the folder
  returns: `manifest.json` · `logic.bin` · `near/0_ix_iz.bin` · `far/1_ix_iz.bin` · `buildings/l0..l2`
  what is there: roads: 500 m tiles of typed pieces with heights (v2), `clamp.json` (v2: the surfaces' cells and outlines), `index.json`
  e.g. `data.pack('./compiled/manifest.json')`
- tools.checks.smoke [built]: `node tools/smoke.mjs`
  params: — (run `npm run examples` first)
  returns: exit 1 on a failure on either WebGPU or WebGL2
  e.g. `node tools/smoke.mjs`
- tools.checks.parity [built]: `node tools/parity.mjs [presets]`
  params: presets (default: every deterministic one)
  returns: the same frame on WebGPU and WebGL2, pixel-diffed; evidence in `.out/parity/`
  e.g. `node tools/parity.mjs parity-globe`
- tools.checks.twins [built]: `node tools/twins.mjs`
  returns: every WGSL shader has its GLSL twin with the same functions and literals; exit 1 otherwise
  e.g. `node tools/twins.mjs`
- tools.checks.regressions [built]: `node tools/checks.mjs [names]`
  params: `names?`: the checks to run (default all but `recipes`; `recipes`, only when named: the authoring guide's recipes by `tools/smoke-recipes.mjs`, the network mocked)
  returns: what headless software rendering once let through (draped marks, blinks, motion, holes, idle frames, rejections…), on WebGPU and WebGL2
  e.g. `node tools/checks.mjs` · `node tools/checks.mjs recipes`
- tools.checks.suite [built]: `node tools/suite-headless.mjs [--gpu real | swiftshader] [--quick] [--only a,b]` · `node tools/suite-report.mjs [result.json]`
  params: `--cpu <×>` · `--uncapped` · `--out file.json`
  returns: the performance suite at phone size, case by case against a reference map library
  e.g. `node tools/suite-headless.mjs --quick`
- tools.checks.perf [built]: `node tools/perf.mjs [demos | gesture | heap | all]`
  params: `PERF_GPU=real` · `PERF_DEMOS=…`
  returns: frame times, CPU, GC, uploads, draws, heap, time to first image and to settled, on WebGPU and WebGL2; budgets fail the run
  e.g. `node tools/perf.mjs gesture`
- tools.checks.recipes [built]: `node tools/smoke-recipes.mjs [names] [webgpu,webgl2]` · `node tools/checks.mjs recipes`
  params: `names?`: the recipes (default all six) or `trials/<name>` (a script a model wrote: what it has, to score it) · `PORT`
  returns: each recipe renders on the graphics asked for, settles, draws a frame neither black nor flat, fails no element, makes no page error, asks nothing from outside unmocked (tools/recipes-mock.mjs answers the services, tiles, data and model), and has what it says; exit 1 on a failure
  e.g. `EXAMPLES_KEEP_BUILD=1 npx vite build && node tools/smoke-recipes.mjs`

not there yet (planned, proposed or open; do not use):
  tools.geo, tools.scan.classify, tools.scan.align, tools.scan.fit, tools.scan.clean, tools.scan.grid,
  tools.compile.run.on-save, tools.compile.run.page, tools.compile.steps.resolve, tools.compile.steps.mesh,
  tools.compile.steps.assign, tools.compile.steps.solids, tools.compile.steps.logic, tools.compile.custom-steps,
  tools.compile.options, tools.compile.stale, tools.convert.fbx, tools.convert.ifc, tools.convert.citygml,
  tools.convert.las, tools.convert.i3s, tools.convert.usd, tools.export.usd, tools.catalog, tools.cli, tools.mcp
